programme.title: Amelie (15)
programme.desc: Améliella on erikoinen tausta, vilkas mielikuvitus ja haaveileva mieli. Vaikka hän tuntuu elävän omassa maailmassaan, hän tekee jatkuvasti pieniä, salaisia tekoja, joilla hän tuo iloa muille. Mutta voiko hänen huoleton elämänkatsomuksensa johtaa hänet hänen oman onnensa ja rakkautensa äärelle? Amélie valloitti maailman, kun elokuvan ainutlaatuinen estetiikka ja lämminhenkinen tarina avasivat yleisön silmät uudelleen ranskalaiselle elokuvalle. Jean-Pierre Jeunet'n suuntaa antavan ja modernin klassikkoelokuvan pääosissa nähdään Audrey Tautou ja Mathieu Kassovitz.

programme.title: Asteroidista selvinneet
programme.desc: Jättimäinen asteroidi iskeytyi maapallolle 66 miljoonaa vuotta sitten ja pyyhkäisi dinosaurusten valtakauden pois. Katastrofista ei selvinnyt yli 500 grammaa painaneita eläimiä. Ketkä selvisivät?

programme.title: Lars Monsenin koiravaljakko
programme.desc: Lars Monsen on osallistunut Iditarodin kilpailuun tätä ennen kahdesti, lähinnä kokemusta hankkiakseen, mutta tällä kertaa on tosi kyseessä. Hänellä on nyt huippuunsa treenattu valjakko, ja hän on valmistautunut hyvin. Lähtöpaikalla Anchoragessa tiimi menettää yhden koiran, mutta Lars saa silti hyvän startin. Puolen vuorokauden päästä Lars tajuaa Alaskavuoristossa, kuinka vaativasta kilpailusta on kyse.

programme.title: Sportliv
programme.desc: Lajinvaihto muutti Ninja Koskisen elämän suunnan. Telinevoimistelun täydellisyyden tavoittelun aiheuttaman ahdistuksen jälkeen hän löysi crossfitin kautta uuden elämäntyylin ja uudenlaisen itseluottamuksen. Nykyään hän voi kutsua itseään uuden lajinsa maailmanmestariksi alle 20-vuotiaiden sarjassa.

programme.title: Äidin ansiosta
programme.desc: Kolme tunnettua nuorta ruotsalaista kertoo, kuinka he ovat toteuttaneet unelmansa ja miten merkittävä rooli heidän suomalaisilla äideillään on ollut heidän elämässään. Kaksiosaisessa dokumentissa tarinansa avaavat kokki Tommy Myllymäki, thainyrkkeilijä Nicholas Bryant ja artisti Adam Tensta Taal.

programme.title: Pesästä lentoon
programme.desc: Nuorten elämässä kouluvuoden loppu on oikeastaan vain uuden alkua.

programme.title: Tiettömän taipaleen takana
programme.desc: Bengt-Are Barstad ei ole käynyt suihkussa kuuteen vuoteen. Ei sen koommin, kun hän muutti erämaahan koiriensa, ahkion ja teltan kanssa. Rakkauden suhteen hän oli jo luovuttanut.

programme.title: Huutokauppakesä
programme.desc: Värmlantilaiset sisarukset Jenna Gillinger ja Johan Åhrén ottavat mittaa tierpiläisestä avioparista Alexandra Englund Lindbergistä ja Alf Lindbergistä. Kilpailu käydään huutokaupassa Husbyssa, Söderköpingin ulkopuolella Itä-Götanmaalla.

programme.title: Jokaisen miehen takana (12)
programme.desc: Kausi 1, 1/8. Keittiömestari Michael joutuu haasteen eteen, kun naispuolinen apulaiskeittiömestari Naja alkaa työskennellä hänen johtamassaan ravintolassa.

programme.title: Jokaisen miehen takana (12)
programme.desc: Najalla on edessään kehityskeskustelu. Kokit Anders ja Lise haastavat toisensa kaksintaisteluun.

programme.title: Sininen laulu: Suomen taiteiden tarina
programme.desc: Suomi vaurastuu, mutta suursota uhkaa jo Eurooppaa, kun Sillanpää noutaa kirjallisuuden Nobelin. Ohjaus Peter von Bagh.

programme.title: Kokkonen Kokkosesta
programme.desc: Ere Kokkonen (1938-2008) oli yksi suomalaisen televisiotuotannon pioneereista. Hän ohjasi myös kymmeniä elokuvia, joista tunnetuimpia ovat Uuno Turhapurot ja Vääpeli Körmyt. Keskeisiä yhteistyökumppaneita olivat Spede Pasanen ja Vesa-Matti Loiri. Ere Kokkonen perusti myös komedialle omistetun teatterin. Ere Kokkosen ja laulaja, näyttelijä Titta Jokisen tytär Kiti Kokkonen jäi vanhempiensa eron jälkeen asumaan isänsä kanssa. Kokkonen Kokkosesta -ohjelmassa hän kertoo Arto Nybergille isänsä työstä ja elämästään, jonka yksi käänne oli Ere Kokkosen uusi avioliitto ja sen myötä syntynyt uusperhe.

programme.title: Lolita Lobosco (7)
programme.desc: Lolitan ensimmäinen koitos kotikonnuilla osoittaa, että asioita ei kannata kaunistella ja aina on viisasta olla varuillaan. Silti pitää uskaltaa katsoa rohkeasti kohti uutta.

programme.title: Gran Hotel (12)
programme.desc: Javierin rakastaja, Jimena-niminen prostituoitu, löydetään murhattuna. Koska paikalliset viranomaiset ovat tottuneita hoitelemaan lähinnä varkauksia ja nujakoita, konstaapeli Hernando kutsuu kaupungista apuvoimia. Ylikomisario Ayala ryhtyy tutkimaan tapausta. Kun Ángela saa tietää poikansa Andrésin ilmeisesti olevan sisäkkö Belénin yhä syntymättömän lapsen isä, hän pyytää Doña Teresaa palkkaamaan Belénin uudestaan. Doña Teresa suostuu, mutta oma suunnitelmansa mielessään: hän tarjoaa Belénille jälleen paikkaa, mutta vain sillä ehdolla, että tämä suostuu myymään lapsensa hänelle. Biologisen äidin sijaan Doña Teresan Sofía-tyttären on määrä esitellä lapsi omanaan. Sofía suostuu toimimaan äitinsä mielen mukaisesti ja esittää jopa aviomiehelleen Alfredolle olevansa yhä raskaana. Samalla Belén suostuu Andrésin kosintaan. Palvelijan asusta revitty nappi johdattaa Julion vastaanottovirkailija Pascualin luo. Vaikka Pascual myöntääkin hukanneensa napin, hänen välttelevät vastauksensa tekevät hänestä Julion mielestä aiempaakin epäilyttävämmän. Alicia löytää Diegon toimistosta kiristyskirjeen, jossa vaaditaan 50 000 pesetan korvausta vaitiolosta Cristinan katoamisen suhteen. Diego väittää kirjeen vastaanottajan olleen eräs hotellin vieraista, mutta tämä paljastuu valheeksi. Itse asiassa hänen itsensä tulee pulittaa vaadittu summa hotellin kassakaapista. Jimenan ruumiinavauksen aikana ylikomisario Ayala löytää sirpaleen kultaisen veitsen kärjestä. Niin arvokas esine voi olla peräisin vain Grand Hotelista, minne Doña Teresa vastentahtoisesti päästää Ayalan suorittamaan tutkimuksiaan. Vain hovimestari Benjamín voi avata kaapin, jossa kultaisia ruokailuvälineitä säilytetään. Hän järjesteli niitä viimeksi yhdessä Julion kanssa.

programme.title: Majakka: Porkkala
programme.desc: Reilut 300 neliötä kolmessa kerroksessa. Vapaat näkymät. Rauhoitettu luoto. Kunnostuskohde. Toimittaja: Tom Backmansson, 1998.

programme.title: Elävä arkisto: Pro arte utili
programme.desc: Ohjelmassa seurataan keramiikkataiteilija Heljä Liukko-Sundströmin työtä Arabian tehtaalla. Hänen tunnetuimmat ja suosituimmat työnsä ovat keramiikkalaatat, joiden aiheet kumpuavat luonnosta ja satujen maailmasta.

programme.title: Kysy lääkäriltä terveydestä
programme.desc: Millaisia alatyyppejä astmalla on? Miten astmaa voi hoitaa? Lääkäri Jens Persson antaa vastauksia näihin ja moniin muihin katsojien kysymyksiin. Tapaamme skellefteålaisen Ethel Hedströmin, joka käy usein lavatansseissa silmäsairaudestaan huolimatta. Ohjelman juontaa Sofia Rågenklint.

programme.title: Livet - suomenruotsalaisia tarinoita
programme.desc: Jannica Lehtinen koki ensimmäisen ikäkriisinsä jo kymmenvuotiaana: jos hän aikoi menestyä artistina, sen oli tapahduttava pian. Niinpä hän yritti menestyä musiikkialalla aivan liian nopeasti ja ajattelematta asiaa loppuun asti. Sen jälkeen hän on tehnyt lujasti töitä itsensä ja musiikkinsa eteen. Enää hän ei enää pelkää epäonnistumistakaan. Toimittaja: Minna Almark.

programme.desc: 2/2. Malin Jacobson Båth on 52-vuotias ja keskellä vaihdevuosia. Hän päätää ottaa ohjelmassaan selvää, mikä vaihdevuosissa on totta ja mikä tarua, ja pureutuu kahdessa jaksossa niin hormonien hullunmyllyyn kuin mielialojen vuoristorataan. Tämä on ohjelma kuumien aaltojen kanssa jo eläville, niille joilla kaikki on vasta edessä, sekä kaikille heidän läheisilleen. Suhteestaan vaihdevuosiin kertovat myös ruotsalaiset julkisuuden henkilöt: päätoimittaja Amelia Adamo, näyttelijä Anna Blomberg, kirjailija Dilsa Demirbag-Sten, päätoimittaja Cissi Elwin, juontaja Anna Mannheimer, valokuvaaja Elisabeth Ohlson Wallin, näyttelijä Amanda Ooms, tv-persoona Mia Parnevik, artisti Zinat Pirzadeh, juontaja Agneta Sjödin, näyttelijä Celie Sparre, toimittaja Lena Katarina Swanberg sekä alppihiihtäjä Pernilla Wiberg.

programme.desc: Eva-Li on tullut Wieniin tapaamaan Albertia, joka opiskelee siellä musiikkia. He tutustuvat kaupungin julkisiin kylpylöihin, kuuluisaan huvipuistoon ja maistavat tietenkin kaupungin parasta schnitzeliä.

programme.title: Tarinoita pikkukaupungista - Tammisaari (S)
programme.desc: Tammisaari oli parinsadan vuoden ajan Ruotsin valtakunnan pienin kaupunki. Nykyään Tammisaaren vanha kaupunki on pääkaupunkiseudun eläkeläisten kesäparatiisi.

programme.title: Näin Ruotsi rakennettiin
programme.desc: Aikakone vie meidät Tukholmaan ja vuoteen 1925, jolloin Ruotsin ensimmäiset pilvenpiirtäjät kohosivat Kungsgatanille. Mark Isitt suuntaa New Yorkiin ja vierailee 1920-luvun korkeimmassa talossa. Petra Meden kaupunkikävelyllä Hötorgsskraporna-tornitaloilla puhkeaa kiivas keskustelu, ja Gert Wingårdh kokee 60-luvun loiston päivät Siw Malmkvistin kanssa Malmössä. Kuuluvatko pilvenpiirtäjät suurkaupunkiin vielä sadan vuoden päästäkin?

programme.title: Yhä hengissä (12)
programme.desc: Sairaalaan tuodaan mies, jolla ei ole henkilöllisyystodistusta, ja Petra ja Joakim alkavat selvittää, kuka tämä on. Samuel yrittää sopeutua lääkärin rooliin vaativia potilaita kohdatessaan.

programme.title: Invisible Heroes (12)
programme.desc: 1/6. Tositapahtumiin pohjautuva draamasarja suomalaisdiplomaateista Chilessä 1973 sotilasvallankaappauksen aikana. Työ kauppasopimusten parissa keskeytyy, kun Allenden kannattajat etsivät kaaoksessa suojaa.

programme.title: Kunnia (12)
programme.desc: Komisario Jasmina yrittää epätoivoisesti pelastaa kahta nuorta norjalaistyttöä pakkoavioliitolta. Samaan aikaan Nora pakenee vanhempiaan.

programme.title: Lars Monsenin koiravaljakko
programme.desc: Lars Monsen on puolivälissä maailman rankinta koiravaljakkokilpailua, Alaskassa ajettavaa Iditarodia. Lars on valmistautunut hyvin, ja hänen valjakkonsa on parempi kuin koskaan. Viimeisimmillä etapeilla hän on edennyt tulosluettelossa 11 sijaa kohti kärkeä. Sitten tapahtuu jotakin odottamatonta.

programme.title: Vatsani ja minä
programme.desc: 21/30. Emilyä alkaa ärsyttää, ettei hän pysty enää hallitsemaan kehoaan. Emma on stressaantunut, koska kätilö ei kuuntele vauvan sydänääniä. Linn valmistautuu vauvan tuloon.

programme.title: Unelmakoti Sisiliassa
programme.desc: Sisilian kesä alkaa kallistua kohti loppuaan. Pernilla Månsson Coltin on aika tulla Palazzo Cirilloon katsomaan, miten Billin ja Marien kuluneen vuoden projektit ovat onnistuneet. Talon pohjakerroksen eteishalli ja yksiö saadaan valmiiksi, ja lopultakin myös viinikellari voidaan sisustaa! Vaan mahtuuko paikalliselta sepältä tilattu viinikaappi sinne?

programme.desc: Uusi kokki Adam Aamann aloittaa työnsä valmistamalla tanskalaisia klassikkoherkkuja. Malin kurkkaa suljettuun ekosysteemiin, jonka hän pani alulle vuosia sitten. Lisäksi hän näyttää, kuinka syntyy tyylikäs pöytäallas. Sisäpihalle nousee kuivamuurattuja viljelyastioita leikkokukille, ja John Taylor ja Pernilla Månsson Colt istuttavat ylellisen säleikköomenapuun.

programme.desc: Vuonna 1997 Espanja marssi yhtenä ihmismerenä ETA:n toimintaa vastaan. Maríaa kohtaa työssä paha isku. Herminia opettaa hänelle, ettei pelolle ja terrorille saa antaa valtaa.

programme.title: Lintumies - vanha balettimestari (S)
programme.desc: Dokumenttielokuva kertoo luopumisesta ja uuteen sopeutumisesta pitkän ja menestyksekkään uran jälkeen. Päähenkilö, 73-vuotias tanssija ja balettimestari Jarmo Rastas, on lopettamassa uraansa Suomen kansallisbaletissa, ja pohtii työn jälkeistä elämää ja omaa identiteettiään. Jarmon tarinaa peilataan myös kolmen tanssijan - Nina Hyvärisen, Tiina Myllymäen ja Michal Krčmářin - kanssa, jotka alansa huippuina tuntevat myös uusien alkujen haasteet. Intiimi dokumenttielokuva on kuvaus tarkoituksen löytämisestä silloin, kun näyttämövalot sammuvat. Käsikirjoitus ja ohjaus: Kaapo Kamu, tuotanto: Noi Films. Dokumentti esitetään Yle Teemalla 2.7.

programme.title: Mullan alta: Janna ja Kevin Tandu
programme.desc: Räppäri Kevin Tandu ja laulaja Janna inspiroituvat L. Onervan voimakkaista ja rohkeista teksteistä. Jakson lopussa mielipiteitä jakaneen, oman aikansa toisinajattelijan runot kuullaan lauluversioina loppukonsertissa.

programme.title: Gran Hotel (12)
programme.desc: Komisario Ayala löytää raskauttavan todisteen, ja uusi mies joutuu epäilyksen alaiseksi. Markiisittaren palvelijatar nuuskii ympäriinsä. Saako Julio selville, kuka oli hänen sisarensa rakastettu?

Maaseudun idylli voi nostaa kyyneleet silmäkulmiin, mutta naiset eivät ole aivan yksimielisiä siitä miltä idyllin kuuluisi näyttää. He kuulevat myös, miten naistaiteilijoita vähäteltiin Fynin taiteilijasiirtokunnassa, ja pääsevät maistamaan linnan nimikkojuomaa.

Myös moni grönlantilainen hylkäsi vanhan elämäntapansa, muutti kaupunkiin ja hankkiutui töihin kalateollisuuteen. Pinnan alla kyti kuitenkin levottomuuksia, sillä kaikki eivät olleet yhtä mieltä siitä, että Grönlannista pitäisi tehdä pieni Tanska.

Entä mikä yhteys talolla on viereisen saaren vankilaan? Tästä kaikesta antiikkiesineiden tuntija Rickard Thunér ottaa selvää. Rakennustutkija Erika Åberg puolestaan kunnostaa yhden ullakkohuoneista lapsille ihanaksi taiteiluhuoneeksi linoleumilattioineen. Ruotsalaissarja, jossa tutustutaan vanhojen talojen historiaan. Inspiraatiota malleihin Line Sander hakee vanhoista amerikkalaisista tikatuista peitteistä. Tanskalainen sarja seuraa neljää muotisuunnittelijaa, joille käsityö ja perinteet ovat tärkeitä.

Kuningatar Margareeta ja Marilyn Monroe ovat hänen innoittajiaan. Tanskalainen sarja seuraa neljää muotisuunnittelijaa, joille käsityö ja perinteet ovat tärkeitä.

programme.title: Poppy's Promise - Secret Life in a Cornfield
programme.desc: The cornfield - just an area for producing food… or a land full of secrets? This doc portrays a little recognized habitat right next door. The spectacular visuals filmed with state of the art equipment introduce the surprisingly large diversity of field inhabitants. We follow a hamster family through a season full of adventures and are drawn into an unknown world – a world of which we thought we knew everything about. In the western industrial nations cornfields and woods take up the greatest proportion of rural land. But how much natural life dwells in a cornfield? Why are some cornfield inhabitants harmful and others useful and what do the colourful flowers at the edge of the field promise us? We follow a hamster family through a season full of adventures and are drawn into an unknown world – a world of which we thought we knew everything about.

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Wild Life, Gentle Nature
programme.desc: As contrasting as the landscapes of the 15th meridian east, so different are its animal inhabitants. What are the living conditions like in the heat of the Namibian Damaraland, in Lusatia or on the coast of Norway? Which challenges do elephants, whales or kingfishers have to master together with their companions from north to south?

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.desc: Almost 11000 kilometres lie between the northernmost and southernmost point of the 15th meridian east. Here you will find extreme landscapes such as the shimmering heat of Africa or the eternal cold of northern Scandinavia. Five people from Spitsbergen, Namibia, Slovenia, Germany and Poland dedicate their lives to environmental protection.

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 Sow, Harvest, Eat – Our Conservatory
programme.desc: This episode focuses on people from five countries who share a common passion: The production of their own food and food. What culinary treasures are hidden in the different regions, from Spitsbergen to Sweden, Austria, Poland and Chad?

programme.title: mareTV: Ibiza - Island of Light
programme.desc: The light of the Balearic island of Ibiza is magical and its trademark: The "Island of Light" is tiny compared to its sister island Mallorca, but offers the most beautiful sunsets in the world. That's what they say. They attract sun worshippers and party people from near and far. To the sounds of the famous "Balearic Sound" they turn night into day. This documentary documents the island in the balancing act between luxury yachts and traditions. Hippie culture, celebrities, pine forests, bays with turquoise water and villages with bright white houses: Ibiza has many faces. Mora (80) and Djin (67) have been drawn to the island for 55 years. They are the uncrowned kings of the hippies. But only love, light, air and laziness, these times are also long gone on Ibiza. Mora knits sexy jerseys for young hippies from morning till night. Djin helps her sell at the famous Las Dalias hippie market and works as a construction worker: chilling and no pension in sight. The virgin Carmen is the patron saint of the sailors. On her day of honour, a mass is celebrated in the port city of Eivissa. Afterwards, fishermen carry the Virgin through the narrow streets of Ibiza City down to the quay. And then Carmen sets sail. Several places on Ibiza claim to offer the most beautiful sunset in the world: In front of Cala de Benirrás, the sun sinks right next to the iconic rock Cap Benat, which the locals awefully call "God's Finger". The typical soft beats over the sea sound from almost all the bays and provide deep relaxation worldwide under the term "Balearic Sound". Some of the famous DJs are jetting around the globe for huge fees. But in the small beach bars, the Chiringuitos, the island sound is celebrated further. On the beach of Cala Salada the Brit Joe Burnley has the command over a troop of mermaids. The ladies squeeze into the tight mermaid costume for the good cause. With great grace they swim towards yachts that are forbidden to anchor on sea grass meadows. Charming but unyielding, they point out the offence to the captain and crew; a creative environmental action to save the endangered Neptune gas, green lung of the sea and habitat for Ibiza's seahorses. The underwater photographer Manu San Felix is also committed to the endangered seahorses. Using a probe, he maps the coastal area around Ibiza and feeds the data into a GPS app. No skipper should be able to say that he didn't even know that his anchor was clawing into Neptune grass. On land, Manu is dedicated to breeding seahorses. His plan: He wants to expose the animals in the Mediterranean to Ibiza and Formentera in order to secure their population. Garages on the beach? Many bays on the island still have Casetas Varadero, boat garages threatened with decay. Fishermen once built them illegally. The picturesque sheds are therefore only tolerated, but may no longer be restored. The 83-year-old Toni Salvado still drives straight out to sea from his garage. He fishes for his own needs and a few friends, he is not allowed to sell his catch.

programme.title: mareTV: Majorca
programme.desc: "Cleaning woman island", concrete castles, Ballermann: Mallorca's image is negatively affected in some respects. The documentary explores the charm of the largest Balearic island beyond the hustle and bustle of tourism and Rambazamba. The "real" Mallorca is best explored through real Majorcans: Manolo Barahona, TV fishing expert from the local island broadcaster IB3, faces the most difficult task of the year. The Raor is in season, the most expensive fish on the island. Manolo is supposed to get him first in front of the camera and then in the pan. There's only one catch, the little fish with the piranha teeth just doesn't want to be on TV. In the first months of the year Mallorca turns into a sea of almond blossoms. There are around seven million almond trees on the island, once planted to replace dead vines. But now also the almond trees are threatened. The fire bacterium continues to spread, especially on the large plantations. The farmer Biel Torrens wants to save Mallorca's almond trees and fruit with a small organic plantation and gentle harvesting methods. He shakes the almonds from the tree by hand instead of using a mechanical vibrator.

programme.title: Mysterious Oceanic Oases - Hotspots of Life
programme.desc: Countless marine animals frolic on the steep slopes of underwater volcanoes. In many cases, several are rare species not found elsewhere. This is in part due to the fact that plankton clings to the wall and provides the fish with food in abundance. This documentary shows several of these oases and also examines the impact dive tourism has and whether preventive measures can help to maintain them. Nature and underwater filmmaker Rolf Möltgen undertakes dives into the mysterious underwater mountain landscapes with marine scientists from all corners of the globe. This journey takes us to Mexico, to snappers, white-tip reef sharks, Galapagos sharks and giant mantas. We visit the Maldives, Colombia and Costa Rica, where the team documents rare species such as deep sea burbots, small tooth sand tiger and dogfish sharks, in depths of more than 3 metres. The eerie underwater mountain world proves: everyone plays a part in the network of life. Thanks to consistent protective regulations, it has been possible to retain the underwater diversity - especially in the unique oases of the high seas

programme.title: New Life
programme.desc: Baby animals beguile with their innocent charm. But while some remain harmless, others have a deep-rooted instinct. It may take weeks or months of training to hone their skills. Their landscapes and lifestyles maybe very different, but these babies are born to hunt.

programme.title: New Life
programme.desc: In a land of dangers, plant-eating animals are always at risk, and never more so than at the time of their birth; out on the open they are vulnerable and there are few places to hide. But luckily some are born to run …

programme.title: New Life
programme.desc: It's a water world and life couldn't survive without it. And thanks to it, a mind blowing diversity of creatures thrive beneath the surface. Born to enjoy the riches underwater they must master their body's adaptations, learn to find food, to escape danger and above all become expert swimmers! Whether it's in rivers, on beaches or in the deep ocean, all must overcome the obstacles and fulfil their destiny, all are born to swim! Of all the habitats on earth, the ocean is perhaps the most challenging. Here salt, temperatures, currents and predators can make life difficult; it's not an obvious place to want to bring up your babies… But even in these waters generation after generation beats the odds. They have overcome the challenges and become some of the most beautiful and graceful of creatures. But any baby born to swim has a lot to learn… All over the world there are creatures born to swim, and though humans are not, we seem determined to join them. Perhaps we are envious of their grace. Maybe we are all water babies at heart

programme.title: Meteor Menace
programme.desc: On February 15th, 2013, out of the blue, a meteorite exploded in the earth’s atmosphere above the Russian region of Chelyabinsk. The event is a reminder of the ever-present 'Meteor Menace' and the need to understand more about these missiles from outer space.

programme.title: The Seychelles - Africa with South Seas ambience
programme.desc: The 115 islands and islets that make up the Seychelles present a breath-taking variety of plants, rare animals and beaches laced with palms. This is where the leg-endary Coco de Mer palm nuts grow with fruits weigh-ing up to 20 kilos and giant wild land turtles nibble away at mangrove fruits to their hearts content. The archipelago was first settled at the end of the 18th cen-tury. Today, a very colourful potpourri of peoples in this dwarf state proves just how peacefully different cultures can live side by side. Three times a week, the steamer "MV Espoir" completes the trip from the main island of Mahé to Praslin and back. A ship for every-one and practically everything: Used cars, toilet paper, horses, bicycles, furniture - you name it, the Espoir transports goods of all kinds. Coconuts sometimes pose a problem as there are far too many of them. What to do with them? The best place to send them is undoubt-edly Hubert Roumien's Virgin Coconut Oil Laboratory, hidden away in the Mahé jungle. Straw turns into gold at Seaweed Seychelles! There, Benjamin Port Louis collects seaweed and extracts liquid fertiliser from it.

programme.title: Vicious Beauties - The secret World of the Jelly Fish
programme.desc: Watching the graceful movement of these gelatinous animals is almost hypnotic. Although their bodies are 98% water, jellyfish are deceptively clever and dangerous. But where do these primordial creatures come from? How do they reproduce and how long do they live?

programme.title: Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape: Episode 1
programme.desc: A few thousand years ago, there were bare moraine ridges and barren meltwater valleys here. A landscape born in the last ice age, characterized by the edge of the Alps, gentle hills, moors, and lakes. And by cultural richness, not only on the islands in Lake Chiemsee, with their famous monasteries and castles. Long before King Ludwig II, the first people settled in the Chiemgau region. Finds of hunting weapons from the Neanderthal era prove that the land was inhabited even during the ice age, probably because there was plenty of game to hunt. During the Bronze Age, one of the most important trade routes from the mountains to the Alpine foothills passed through here. Then came the Celts and the Romans.

programme.title: Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape: Episode 2
programme.desc: Three times in the past two decades, the Chiemsee area has experienced "once-in-a-century" floods. Climate, wildlife, and landscape have changed, and it seems this transformation is accelerating. Species living in the flood zones are developing sophisticated survival strategies. Knot ants, for instance, place their queen in the middle and form a raft with their bodies, even conquering new habitats. Flooding is less of a disaster for nature and impacts humans more significantly.

programme.title: mareTV: Sweden's High Coast
programme.desc: Sweden's Höga Kusten (High Coast) has been rising by almost one centimetre per year since the last ice age 10,000 years ago. This has created a hilly Baltic Sea landscape on the Gulf of Bothnia with small and large islands. Untouched nature, dense forests and energetic, rather idiosyncratic islanders have plenty of room there. Every year at the end of August a biting stench mixes with the fresh Baltic Sea breeze. For weeks the so-called sour herring, Swedish: Surströmming, is fermented in brine. Ruben Madsen is a producer of surströmming and an absolute connoisseur. In his wooden hut on the island of Ulvön he puts the herring in according to a traditional recipe. At the start of the season, the cans are opened for the first time. Lovers of the "stinky fish" then come from all over the world to taste the now world-famous delicacy in cans. Opening the cans of "rotten fish" is considered internationally as a test of courage, people film themselves doing so, the inhabitants of the High Coast can only smile about it.

programme.title: mareTV: Estonia's Enchanted Islands - Kihnu, Hiiumaa, Saaremaa & Co
programme.desc: Kihnu is one of 19 inhabited Estonian islands. When the women there ride motorcycles in colourful skirts, it is summer. Thanks to its remoteness, charming traditions have been preserved here. More than 2,000 islands belong to Estonia, none is like the other, each with its own character. Most of them were military restricted areas during the Soviet Union. Of all things, the strict shielding had its good points: beach, forest, juniper groves, they still characterise the landscape of Estonia's enchanted islands. Elly Karjam is a "multi-jobber": lighthouse keeper, ice-cream producer and contract knitter for the famous Kihnu sweaters. Summer is high season for her: She is expecting guests from the USA, who had their ancestors on Kihnu. Birches have to be cut for the so-called viht. This bunch of birch branches is an important accessory for the traditional sauna at midsummer. And the motorcycles in the shed are to be refloated.

programme.title: Symphony of the Seas - Underwater Wonders of Australia's Ocean
programme.desc: Our journeys take us all around the world from Patagonia to the USA, from Greenland to South Africa and from Cambodia to Australia and leads us to the most fascinating places where landscapes animals and humans are the main focus of our documentaries. Whether on land or at sea – the last paradises of the world are our destination.

programme.title: Secrets of the Mediterranean
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Secrets of the Mediterranean, Ep.1
programme.desc: The contours of the Mediterranean have changed during the course of its history. Near Gibraltar, Africa was once connected to the European continent. When the land bridge at Gibraltar collapsed, the Mediterranean basin filled up again. The Suez Canal is today connected to the Red Sea. This route enables animals to reach the Mediterranean, where they cause problems.

programme.title: Secrets of the Mediterranean
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Secrets of the Mediterranean, Ep. 2
programme.desc: Rugged rocks, blue sea and idyllic, sandy beaches - this is the Mediterranean as we know it. But this impression is deceptive: the Mediterranean is under constant change. The continents are moving towards one another. Animals, that have to survive under such extreme conditions, must find a way to escape the dangers. Between deserts and volcanoes, the challenges for the animals are enormous.

programme.title: Northern Woods
programme.desc: It is a musical film a a tributeto the Nordic forest: it shows its development from a primeval wood to a cultivated forest. Once populated by wild animals such as wolves, bears, eagles, deer and musk oxen, complex re-enactment-scenes shot by dollies and helicopters vividly depict the colonization of the forest by the Celts and Germans. But as time progressed, the northern forest has on numerous occasions fallen victim to environmental degradation and overexploitation. Several provisions were made to protect this wild beauty. The Helsinki resolution of 1993, which stipulated that the woods be used in a way and in a magnitude which guarantees their biological variety and productiveness and vitality, is but one measure put in place to secure the preservation of the natural gem. Time-lapse photography and breath-taking shots show our main protagonist – the woods – in its stunning glory. This beautiful wooded land, changes throughout the seasons. Our woodland is a world-renowned ecological jewel. It is famous, well-known and loved by tourists, forest economists, environmentalists, historians and intellectuals alike.

programme.title: Lobsters - The Knights Of The Deep
programme.desc: The knights of the deep are on the move; almost no part of their bodies is without armor. Like medieval warriors, these fighters are well armed – not with sword and shield, but with scissors and forceps and defensive armor that is covered with spikes and hooks. And even though they are well protected and have an uncanny awareness of their surroundings, many of these proud knights will face a gloomy destiny. Many of them will end upon a plate. Gourmets all over the world are in love with these famous crustaceans: lobsters! For marine biologists lobsters are similarly fascinating: as research objects. We are on their trail in Cape Breton, an island in the northern Atlantic and part of the Canadian province Nova Scotia, where one of the largest populations of lobsters has its home.

programme.title: Chasing Quakes
programme.desc: Europe has experienced catastrophic earthquakes – even though the 'old continent' is not the most notorious region on Earth for strong quakes, the danger from below is very real. Autumn 2016 tragedy strikes north-central Italy. A series of four earthquakes cracks a mountain and flattens a historic town.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: It is a road of mountain passes and India’s access to the roof of the world – the Himalayas. This 475-kilometre long route at the northernmost tip of the Indian subcontinent connects the cities of Manali and Leh at the heart of the Ladakh region. The term “highway” applies quite literally, since the route traverses five of the highest drivable mountain passes in the world – among these the Lohtang La at 3,978 metres above sea level, the Lachulung La at 5,059 metres and the Tanglang La at 5,325 metres. Crossing these passes is a challenge for both vehicle and man. The mountain peaks, still snow-capped even in the depths of summer, wide variety of vegetation and the fantastic and craggy landscape turn any journey into a captivating adventure.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 The Nawabpur Road in Dhaka
programme.desc: In Bangladesh, the land with the highest density of population in the world (and the highest amount of corruption), the daily struggle to survive is fought everywhere, including the streets. Nowhere do people drive as brutally and recklessly as here. In Bangladesh you drive on the road like others drive with a bumper car: if you need space, you simply ram the car driving next to you. The police only came if there are fatalities. The biggest bottleneck in the transport system is the historical old town of Dhaka. Old Dhaka is a universe of its own, a world of bazaars in which every trade has its own quarter: there are streets of jewelers, sweets makers and fashionable tailors, and the vegetable wholesalers have their warehouses down at the port. The deliveries take place mostly on the river, the Buriganga River, a stinking cesspool. But the sold goods usually leave by land, and the customers also come by the land route – the Nawabpur Road. They generally come in buses or by rickshaw, where too many people are crammed into too little space. The traffic in Dhaka is everyday, normal madness. The film accompanies a rickshaw, a bus and a truck on their dangerous way through the streets of Dhaka and shows how it is possible to survive in what seems to be an incontrollable chaos.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The “Adriatic Highway” is one of the most beautiful coastal roads in the world. The “technical masterwork” was built in the 1950s and 60s, at the time of Yugoslavian President Tito. Abounding in curves, the asphalt road stretches from Ankaran in Slovenia to Ulcinj in Montenegro. More than half of the road is in Croatia (659 km) and a quarter in Montenegro (125 km). Shorter segments lead through Slovenia; only nine kilometers are in Bosnia and Herzegovina. For all four countries of the former Yugoslavian Federation, the 1,200-kilometer-long highway remains the main thoroughfare of Adriatic tourism. For many travelers, the highway is the absolute dream road. In dizzying heights, it hugs the steep cliffs lining the Adriatic Sea, winds through coves and bays, gardens and stony fields. Wonderful views of the blue sea, green islands, bizarre cliffs and Mediterranean cities and towns are typical of the highway. But with its numerous curves, the dream road also harbors many dangers.

programme.title: mareTV: Madeira - Portugal's sea of blossoms in the Atlantic Ocean
programme.desc: Flower magic in Madeira: The Flower Festival Festa da Flor is the most important event of the year for the people of the Atlantic island. With it they celebrate spring, which is climatically practically all year round here, their island and themselves. The coast formed by lava, centuries-old laurel forests and green steep slopes make Madeira unique. Those who start right at the front of the big parade of the flower festival in the capital Funchal, will have made it. For Isabel Borges this dream has come true. She opens this year's flower parade along the harbour promenade with her festive group. This accolade does not only mean fame and prestige, but also a lot of pressure. Are the self-designed dresses splendid enough? Will the 150 flower children learn the dance steps in time? Will the flowers on the float hold out in the heat? For Isabel, it is now a matter of nerves.

programme.title: mareTV: La Palma: The Greenest of the Canaries
programme.desc: Thundering waterfalls, ancient forests and an impressive volcanic landscape with black beaches: La Palma is a dream island for nature lovers. It is by far the island of the Canary Islands with the most green, almost half of it is covered with forest. But once a year the green island is dominated by the color white. On Rosenmontag (Rose Monday), the inhabitants have for decades been targeting those ancestors who returned from abroad wealthy and ostentatiously demonstrated their wealth with powdered faces. The carnivalistic approach culminates every year in a white chaos, with tons of talcum, flour or paint trickling down the uniformly white dressed islanders. On the Roque de los Muchachos, La Palma's highest mountain at 2,400 meters, stands one of the largest reflecting telescopes in the world. Astrophysicists love the island because it is the perfect place to look into space. Researchers and star lovers look spellbound to Beteigeuze. The giant star is probably in front of a supernova and could become a second moon in the firmament.

programme.title: Giants of Fortune - The Whale Sharks of Oslob
programme.desc: In the little Filipino village of Oslob on the Cebu Island, people suffer from typhoons and overfishing. Until the world’s biggest fish and the Internet change everything.Fisherman Zosimo’s dearest wish is for his children to graduate from high school one day. Yet the chance that this wish will come true is tiny, since at times Zosimo doesn’t even manage to feed the family. Typhoons and overfishing make the lives of Oslob fishermen difficult.

programme.title: The marvellous World of French Rivers
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Marvellous french Rivers - Girone
programme.desc: The Gironde is the largest and most powerful tidal current in Europe. When the Gironde flows into the Atlantic, it is 15 kilometers wide and in the rhythm of the tides, it brings the waters from the Pyrenees and the Massif Central into the ocean. This often pushes its waters far out into the Gironde at high tide.This creates a world of its own that has shaped everything uniquely and intensely for tens of thousands of years. The water surface of the river is so large that the evaporation has created its own microclimate, which is stable and, together with the brackish waters, has influenced flora and fauna on the right and left of the bank for a long time.

programme.title: The marvellous World of French Rivers
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Marvellous french Rivers - Dordogne
programme.desc: The Dordogne consists of a visible and an invisible system of flowing water. Caves and basins under the earth's surface store the excess water and return it to the river when it is dry. A perfect management of a precious resource, not invented by humans, but by the complex nature itself. The result is an ever life-giving river.

programme.title: mareTV: Jersey - Sunshine Island in the English Channel
programme.desc: Jersey: the Channel Island is one of the areas in the UK that can boast the most hours of annual sunshine. Not that Dave Cowburn cares very much. He works in the dark, cool ducts of an old bunker from the Sec-ond World War. Here, he breeds turbot, and is very successful at it, too. The "Jersey Royal", the regal potato, has been grown on the island since 1880, fertilized with seaweed from the surrounding ocean. In the third generation, Christine Hellio manages approximately 20 hectares on the coast. "The potato is our most important export commodity", she says. It is harvested by hand, as machines cannot be used on the steep fields. The price is quite regal, too: One kilogram costs 6 Euros. Hugh Gill is one of around 240 voluntary police officers on Jersey. The Honorary Police is regarded as the oldest organised police system in the world. Hugh works for them for one week every month. On the green lanes, the streets of Jersey, the speed limit is 15 miles per hour. Jersey has an immense tidal range and with up to 13 metres difference, it is the world's third largest. This is good for a rarity: the Ormer - one of the world's most expensive species of snail.

programme.title: The Provence coast - Marseille and the Côte Bleue
programme.desc: The Provence is famed for its endless fields of laven-der, but this lush landscape also has a beautifully mari-time touch: The Côte Bleue! Small, hidden beaches, charming harbour towns, imposing, craggy bays and a uniquely clear light that has attracted painters includ-ing Cézanne and Braque. The coast derives its name from the deep blue water and extends from Marseille to Martigues. This small town is also known as "The Ven-ice of the North", as it is shaped entirely by water: an inland lake, the sea itself, as well as a connecting canal. In the bays of the Calanques, the steeply-walled coastal inlets in the Mediterranean limestone, Lionel Franc is a cliff diver. His personal record is a hight of 36 metres! Ambi is a sculptress. This young artist's work, who moved to Marseille from Madagascar many years ago, is characterised by a dynamic momentum. As a pas-sionate pétanque player, she demonstrates this drive on the boules courts of the port city. John Pendray is Pein-tre officiel de la Marine, an official marine painter. The French state allows just 40 painters to its circle. There are no monetary rewards, but heaps of honour and a very smart uniform!

programme.title: Eyes Of The Atacama
programme.desc: ALMA – the Atacama Large Millimeter Array – is the ultimate space observation facility. Here, 66 leviathan parabolic antennae trap cosmic rays in the previously unobservable long-wave range. It can only happen in Atacama, far away from civilisation’s pollution of the night sky with artificial light.

programme.title: Tren Atlantico
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 In the Heart of Portugal
programme.desc: We travel by train from the westernmost point of mainland Europe up to Portugal's only national park, the Peneda-Gerês, and from lively Porto to the Spanish border in the northeast. The train takes you from the blue sea to the green Douro Valley, from the urban metropolis to the scorching heat of the deserted hinterland.

programme.title: Tren Atlantico
programme.desc: Switzerland or Spain? This question is often asked by those who see pictures from northern Spain for the first time: High mountains, lonely villages, but - this is the crucial difference - also breathtaking Atlantic beaches. The "Costa Verde", the green coast, is a piece of Spain that is so different from the general tourist image of the Germans' favorite vacation destination. This area has been spared from mass tourism. We travel by train from Bilbao in the Basque Country to Santander in Cantabria and Asturias.

programme.title: Germany's Wild Amazon
programme.desc: As one of Germany’s beauties, the river was the gem of Germanys landscape. But with industrialization it became the country’s hardest working river and like everything that has been overworked, it lost it magnificence and charm. Due to tender love and care, the river is now a reigning example of one of the most successful and outstanding renaturation projects in the country.The film shows never before seen shots of the river now pulsing with life. We will show you the winding river bed, spawning salmon, mating crabs and still-growing anchor ice. You will see dipper birds searching for food under water, kingfishers catching fish, a family life of badgers, foxes and a wide variety of birds. Come and meet the resurrected river Wupper!

programme.title: Germany's Wild Reservoirs
programme.desc: One of the smallest dams in the Bergisches Land is the Panzertalsperre, with an area of just four-and-a-half football pitches. On the other hand, the Dhünntalsperre is the largest with the area of 660 football pitches. They all transform a stretch of flowing water into still and stagnant water. As a result, completely diverse ecosystems have developed there: where the dipper once dived for insect larvae, cormorants and gray herons now fish and swans and coots cavort. In recent summers, even greater challenges have emerged: the effects of climate change - from extreme drought to destructive floods. On a smaller scale, a rather industrious dam master is operating flood protection: The Beaver. However, the water masses of the Wupper tore away half of his majestic timber castle - and the four young beaver kids were not seen again afterwards. Have they survived the flood? Not everyone can cope with the constant change in the dams, but they still remain an important wonder of engineering for many: for us humans as well as for a number of animals. By combining water management, ecological requirements and tourism a worthwhile goal is possible: Because for the Bergisches Land, its dams are among the most valuable and popular infrastructures that the region has to offer.

programme.title: The Sun - Inferno in the Sky
programme.desc: On July 23rd, 2012, a massive eruption on the sun hurls a colossal cloud of solar matter into space. It’s the most severe sunstorm in 150 years. Fortunately, the Earth is not in the direct path of this solar ejection. But it’s only a matter of time before a violent solar storm hits us. When these clouds of charged matter reach our planet, they can wreak havoc in electrical systems.

programme.title: Deadly Roads
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Bolivia, Ivory Coast, Georgia
programme.desc: Roads are more than just gray strips of asphalt that allow us to travel and trade. For centuries they have been lifelines of mankind, full of stories and history - and in certain countries and areas they also hold great dangers, much human suffering and death. Documentary filmmaker Oliver G. Becker ventured onto the dangerous roads of Afghanistan's Hindu Kush Mountains, the infamous Moloto Road in South Africa, along the vertiginous slopes of the Bolivian Andes and other "roads of death" in India, Georgia and the Ivory Coast

programme.title: Deadly Roads
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Afghanistan, South Africa, India
programme.desc: Some risks on these autoroutes have natural causes: Extreme weather, avalanches and landslides. In some areas, the locals even believe that evil spirits kill travelers. But many of the dangers are man-made: robbers or terrorists lie in wait for travelers, and tough labor pressures, social hardship and greedy mass-transit businesses also cause tragic driving accidents around the world. In the 20th century alone, 35 million people died on roads worldwide - plus 1.5 billion injured! With the two-part "Death Roads - On the Road at the Limit," phoenix offers a documentary road movie along the world's most dangerous car routes.

programme.title: Menorca - Majorca's beautiful sister
programme.desc: Not nearly as crowded as Majorca or Ibiza: Menorca has noticeably fewer visitors than her sister islands and in 1993, was recognised by UNESCO as a biosphere re-serve. Menorca also has its own distinctive charm, with its secluded coves, mighty cliffs, beautiful gardens and ages old towns and villages. Its residents love the is-lands treasures and peculiarities. Forests make up al-most a third of Menorca, complemented by many lush green meadows. Next to tourism, agriculture is a major source of the island's income to the present day. On Menorca, there are several accumulations of enormous megalithic stones. From a global point of view, the up to five-metre-tall "Taulas", whereby the stones are ar-ranged in the shape of a "T", are unique.

programme.title: Wild Sardinia
programme.desc: Sardinia has always been the epitome of pure wilderness, an emerald of volcanic origin in the Mediterranean. 1900 metres of coastline and an infinite maze of offshore islands. But Sardinia also has other facets: green valleys, rugged mountains, murmuring brooks, mysterious ruins and a unique fauna. Just off of Sardinia's coast is an untouched underwater paradise - uniquely beautiful, but also dangerous. Pilot whales, dolphins and mobula rays populate the waters at Capo Testa in the north of the island. In the west, the lagoons of Cabras represent a wild landscape of lakes in which thousands of flamingos live and hunt the red brine shrimps. In addition to the flamingos, grey and purple herons and little egrets breed here. Thousands of bats have found refuge in the craggy mountain world of the Supramonte and Gennargentu, with their countless grottoes and caves. In the sea we can observe the mass mating of sea slugs, and thanks to our camera robots and submersible boats we were able to observe beard worms with luminous red gills, as well as bright yellow tree corals in the area surrounding the hypothermal lava holes.

programme.title: mareTV: Tenerife - The Queen of the Canaries
programme.desc: Tenerife is outstanding among the Canary Islands. If only because of the volcano Pico del Teide, which rises exactly 3.718 meters above sea level and is thus the highest mountain in Spain. But not only scenically Tenerife, the largest of the Canary Islands, stands out...

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 One Year in Norway's Lofoten: Episode 1
programme.desc: Winter means more than just the beginning of the year for the people of Lofoten: For more than a thousand years, Lofoten has been a hub for cod fishing, with seasons lasting from February to April as huge shoals migrate from the Barents Sea to these waters. During these hectic months, more than 65,000 tons of fish are brought to shore, securing the income for the whole of Lofoten for years to come. Around a quarter of the fish caught ends up on lines to dry upon racks. From a young age, the children from the fishing villages get to earn some pocket money by cutting cod tongues and selling the produce as a delicacy appreciated by the locals.

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 One Year in Norway's Lofoten: Episode 2
programme.desc: Almost unnoticeably, spring turns into summer. The days become longer and longer, with a never-setting sun. People who have spent their winter and spring working hard can finally enjoy their own nature, even though the temperature is only slightly warmer. Lofoten is sparsely populated, just 24,000 people live here. Unstad is one of its smallest communities with only 15 inhabitants, but despite that, it has become a hotspot for arctic surf and is host to the northern-most surf center in the world. Surfers from all over the globe come to surf in the arctic water.

programme.title: Survival of the Fittest in the Alps
programme.desc: The documentary shows the survival strategies of various animal species in the high mountains of the Alps in winter. Despite freezing temperatures and limited food supply, chamois, red deer and snow hares manage to survive the cold months. Latest research reveals the amazing abilities the animals have developed to adapt to the extreme conditions and also how climate change is altering the behaviour of the alpine inhabitants.

programme.title: Wild Bavaria
programme.desc: The moon disappears behind the horizon and the stage is set for a new day in the Alps of Berchtesgaden.

programme.title: Wild Bavaria
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Wild Bavaria - In The Shadow of the Watzmann.
programme.desc: Mighty and mysterious, King Watzmann sits above Germany's only alpine national park.

programme.title: Women Above the Clouds
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Across Alaska in a Cessna
programme.desc: Alaska - the largest and at the same time most sparsely populated state in the USA. Only about 740,000 people live here. Often far away in small villages. Almost every village has its own airstrip. Aircrafts are one of the main means of transport in Alaska. Jamie Klaes is one of the many female pilots in the country.

programme.title: Women Above the Clouds
programme.desc: Aerobatics is the supreme discipline in air sports. Only a few pilots dare to navigate a machine during loops, drops and steep flights because nausea and blackouts due to the strong G-forces can be life-threatening. But flight instructor Jenny Holmenes is not deterred - she wants to prove her skills. Although she is still a beginner, she competes in the "Sportsman" class at the Norwegian Aerobatic Championships.

programme.title: Women Above the Clouds
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 Bush Pilots in the Australian Outback
programme.desc: Living conditions are harsh in the Australian outback, especially in William Creek. Only 17 people live here, and in summer even less - only two. There is a motel, a campsite, a pub and the only petrol station in a radius of hundreds of miles. The young bush pilot Hannah Jane Cash lives and works here.

programme.title: Faroe Islands - A Secret Beauty
programme.desc: The Faroe Islands in the North Atlantic, located in the middle of the Gulf Stream between Scotland and Iceland, are an archipelago of eighteen green volcanic islands where a unique culture has developed over the last thousand years. As direct descendants of the Vikings, the Faroese feel committed to their traditions and hold on to customs, without missing out on the advantages of the modern and globalised world - from archaic hunter and shepherd culture to contemporary art. With the highest birth rate in Europe and the lowest social inequality in the world, the just fifty thousand Faroese are a very special people living on one of the last natural paradises in Europe.

programme.title: Countries People Adventures - Iceland Extreme
programme.desc: In southeastern Iceland, Europe's largest glacier, the gigantic Vatnajökull, covers an area of around 9,000 square kilometers. Beneath it lie the world's most active and dangerous volcanoes. This extreme landscape is as dangerous as it is fascinating: glistening white glacier tongues, lagoons covered with icebergs, bizarre green lava mountains, snow-covered volcanic cones, solidified lava flows and imposing waterfalls overwhelm everyone who gets to see them. In 2008, Icelanders declared the glacier and adjacent areas a national park, the largest in Europe. In this documentary, the team meets people who live, work or do research here: a life with the dangers of fire and ice in the overwhelming landscape of Vatnajökull National Park.

programme.title: Gronland - In the Glare of Ice
programme.desc: Greenland is the largest island in the world and the landmass closest to the North Pole. 80% of the country is covered by a layer of ice up to 3000 meters thick. Most of the inhabitants of the country are spread over the breathtaking landscape of the ice-free west coast. The country is mostly inhabited by Inuit, who have been feeding on what nature has provided them for thousands of years. But the original life is in a state of change. The modernisation of society and man-made global warming threaten the Arctic natural paradise that is so incredibly important for our planet. Through the eyes of locals we get to know the authentic Greenland.

programme.title: World's Most Dangerous Railway Lines
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 The Bernina Express, Suisse
programme.desc: Over 196 bridges and through 55 tunnels, the Bernina Express fights its way from Switzerland to Italy. Powerful forces of nature make the railyway line a dangerous route over the Grisons Alps to this day. The film accompanies the Bernina Express in winter over the highest rail route across the Alps.

programme.title: World's Most Dangerous Railway Lines
programme.desc: The Tanzania-Zambia-Railway (Tazara) is one of Africa's most ambitious infrastructure projects. It connects the inland with the coast of East Africa and meant independence from the surrounding apartheid-ruled countries of East Africa. The film accompanies the Tazara on its 52-hour journey through Tanzania and Zambia and uses spectacular aerial shots to show not only the architectural monuments but also the unknown sides of the previously hidden landscapes of Tanzania and Zambia.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Shot In the While Sleeping (Richard Alessandri Case): On the night of July 16, 2000, the life of Edwige Alessandri changed forever. This mother, married to a supermarket boss, made a frantic emergency call in the town of Carpentras. She recounted that shortly after midnight, some men burst into her room and shot her husband while he slept. Who could have despised Richard Alessandri enough to kill him in cold blood in his own bed? Was he the victim of a robbery gone wrong, as claimed by his wife?

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A Dire Deception (LAURENCE MAILLE CASE): On November 28, 2007, Laurence Maille disappeared. It was her partner, John Zablevski, who alerted the Vimy police in Pas-de-Calais. He explained that the young woman had left in the morning for a walk with their dog and never returned. An unprecedented search was immediately launched to try to find her. Beautiful, intelligent and generous, Laurence Maille had everything to be happy about and for 18 months, had found the perfect love in her partner.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The Mystery of Room 602 (Véronique Pirotton Case): On October 31, 2013, Belgian politician Bernard Ouessfal rushed down the six flights of a hotel in Ostend where he had met up with his wife, Véronique, the day before. He had just found her unconscious on the bathroom floor with a mysterious plastic bag next to her. Despite the emergency rescue response, Véronique Pirotton died a few minutes later.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Two Accused of Murder (Jennifer Charron Case) - On Sunday, April 29, 2007, the body of Jennifer Charron, 21-years old, was found burnt to a crisp in a forest near Royan. The young waitress, who had been missing for two days, was visibly beaten and tied up. In this astonishing case, the clues examined by the experts will give them two leads: two men, two suspects with very different profiles... but investigators are convinced that they both have a direct link with the murder.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: THE CASE OF STÉPHANE KAMEUGNE - On December 24, 2008, the body of Stéphane Kameugne was fished out from a canal in Châlons-en-Champagne. The young man had been missing for two weeks and no one had seen him since the evening of his graduation ceremony from his engineering school. A theory soon emerged: the very drunk student had fallen over thea bridge over the canal which led to his death. But his parents and relatives did not believe this.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The Savage Murder of a Mother and her Daughter (Amato Case)- On March 31, 2003, firefighters were called to a fire in a housing estate of Meyrargues, near Aix-en-Provence. On site, they discovered a horrific scene: the tortured and charred bodies of a mother and her daughter, Chantal and Audrey D'Amato, aged 53 and 24 respectively.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A Night of Horror at Devil's Plateau (Marie-Jeanne Meyer Case) - On June 18, 2011, Marie-Jeanne Meyer, 17-years old, waved goodbye to her little sister before leaving for her daily jog on the heights of Tournon in Ardèche. She never came back. Three days later, her mutilated body was found in a freshly dug pit, near an area known to be cursed, "The Devil's Plateau." What's more, the crime scene looked like a mystical ritual ... Was it a ritual murder? Revenge? An unfortunate encounter? ...

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A Mysterious Murder at the Farm (Valérie Bary Case)- On Friday, March 26, 2004, in the region of Dijon, Laurent Bary came home from his work to discover the lifeless body of his wife, Valerie, bathing in a pool of blood. According to the investigators' initial findings, the 38-year-old nurse's aid had been stabbed several times, seeming to validate the theory of a robbery gone wrong.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On July 13, 2011, two boaters retrieved a suitcase that was floating in the bay of Lorient. Inside, they discovered the tied up corpse of a man.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Bloody Christmas next to the Leman lake (CASE OF RUTH LÉGERET) - On January 4, 2006, Ruth Légeret was found dead in the middle of a pool of blood at her luxurious property in Vevey, Switzerland. Next to her was the lifeless body of her friend, Marina Studer. Who could have killed these two simple and wealthy widows? Clue after clue, the Swiss police's investigation would revolve around an environment of family jealousy and financial greed.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: September 16 2005. The lifeless body of Audrey Jouannet, 24, is found hidden under the bed in her small apartment in Soisy-sur-Seine. It soon becomes apparent that the young woman has been tortured at length before being strangled. But surprisingly, though the highly meticulous murderer has taken care to leave no sign of his passage, the autopsy reveals traces of sperm on the victim. It will take all of the investigators' intuition to pierce the mystery of this heinous crime...

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Sylvain Dromard finds the body of his wife Laurence lying in a pool of blood in the kitchen. The crime was particularly violent and the theory of a burglary that went wrong is soon excluded. But investigators don't understand who could want the adorable hairdresser of Saint-Martin-d'Ablois dead. During the investigation, the work of profilers will enable them to draw a very precise portrait of the murderer...

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: After an ordinary dinner, Pierre and Gabrielle Labrell suffer severe abdominal pains.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Nelly Crémel, 39, leaves her home to go jogging... never to return. Eight days later, after a vast search campaign, her body is found. There's no doubt that it's murder. The case soon ignites public opinion, even inflaming passions at the highest level of the state. The clues lead investigators on a number of trails, from the shadows of the French secret service to a manhunt for a possible sex maniac, in a case of murder most foul.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Willy Pomonti, a retired architect, is found savagely murdered in his opulent villa in La Celle-Saint-Cloud, near Paris.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The lifeless body of Christophe Lejard is found by his son just metres from their home.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A man walks into a gendarmerie near Saint-Malo to report that his wife has been missing since the previous day. The couple are going through a divorce, but this mother would never have left her seven children alone! An extensive search is undertaken but the woman cannot be found. What has happened to Adeline Piet? The investigation spans several years and experiences many twists.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The corpse of Priscillia Ciatti, 14, is discovered by the side of a field, a few hundred metres from her family home. The teenager has been stabbed sixty times with a knife and -an extra sordid detail - a devil mask is found next to her body. Was Priscillia the victim of a prowler? A serial killer? A maniac inspired by a horror movie? Investigators soon find that the young girl felt she was being watched, and even threatened...

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: In the early hours of the morning, Mathilde Croguennec, 18, attending "Teknival" in Brittany, is found at the foot of a tree with her throat cut. Investigators face the task of finding the killer from among the 43,000 participants of this huge open-air festival of electronic music, where drink and drugs are consumed in abundance. An unusual investigation that leads the police down a number of false avenues.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Arriving at her work, the secretary of a small firm in the suburbs of Geneva finds the body of Jean-Raymond Blatti, the company's new accountant. The man is lying in a pool of blood and, on his belly, the murderer has written "DIRTY RAPIST". Yet Jean-Raymond Blatti was never charged with sexual assault. Over the course of the investigation, this inscription will appear as one of the many mysteries of this case which is particularly rich in twists and turns.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On July 19th 2004, the naked and tied up body of a woman is recovered in the Ourcq canal in Fresnes-sur-Marne. The victim is impossible to identify.

programme.title: The Tracker's Diary: Bears of Katmai
programme.desc: In Katmai National Park, Alaska a massive population of coastal brown bears gather to eat salmon as they migrate back to the rivers and streams where they were born.

programme.title: The Tracker's Diary: Bears of Katmai
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Fish Like a Bear
programme.desc: The crew heads inland to a section of the river to observe the many different families as they fish.

programme.title: The Tracker's Diary: Bears of Katmai
programme.desc: During a lull in bear and salmon activity, Casey and the crew decide to head inland in search of the spawning fish.

programme.title: The Tracker's Diary: Bears of Katmai
programme.sub-title: S01 : E04 The Wolf and The Storm
programme.desc: After seeing a wolf in the distance and tracks on the shore, the crew head inland in search of more clues to the wolf's whereabouts.

programme.title: The Tracker's Diary: Bears of Katmai
programme.sub-title: S01 : E05 Neighbors, Old and New
programme.desc: Casey and the crew go out in search of the family of the lost cub from the previous night. They hope that if they find them, the cub will have found them as well.

programme.sub-title: S01 : E06 No Place Like Home
programme.desc: As the end of their expedition draws near, salmon and bear activity begins to decline, but that doesn’t mean that there aren’t some bears still lingering around the area.

programme.title: The Secret Lives of Sharks
programme.desc: Travel to South Africa, one of the world's great shark hot spots, as Andy Casagrande observes the iconic great white shark and its behavior when hunting fur seals.

programme.title: The Secret Lives of Sharks
programme.desc: Travel to the Bahamas as Andy Casagrande attempts to place a fin camera on the elusive hammerhead shark… what could possibly go wrong?

programme.title: The Secret Lives of Sharks
programme.desc: Wildlife filmmaker Andy Casagrande travels off the coast of North Carolina to document never before seen behavior of one of the most misunderstood sharks in the world.

programme.title: Nature Through Her Eyes
programme.desc: Partnerships between men and women, young and old, black and white, give us a fresh appreciation for the creatures we share this earth with.

programme.title: Breakthrough
programme.desc: Great white sharks are one of the most feared predators on Earth, and yet we know very little about them. Science is now revealing the mysteries.

programme.sub-title: S01 : E27 The Mystery Of The Longest Living Vertebrate
programme.desc: New information from the eye of the Greenland Shark confirms it is the longest living vertebrate on Earth.

programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Who Tells The Story?
programme.desc: Many of nature’s greatest champions are women. Can their storytelling help restore balance to a troubled world?

programme.title: American Icons
programme.desc: He wasn't always the greatest strategist and tactician, and he actually made a lot of mistakes early on. But George Washington was a leader unlike any other.

programme.title: American Icons
programme.desc: Thomas Edison had no small ego and liked to promote himself as a lone inventor. But you can't take out 1100 patents in your lifetime by yourself. Instead, he built the first research and development laboratory, decades before anyone else in America understood the value of such a collaboration.

programme.title: American Icons

programme.title: American Icons

programme.title: American Icons

programme.title: JFK: Fact & Fable
programme.desc: Television made John Kennedy the ultimate celebrity during his presidency. However, the JFK we remember is the one his wife, Jackie, created after his death.

programme.title: Presidents In Crisis

programme.title: The Company Men
programme.desc: Bobby Walkerilla on unelmatyö, kuvankaunis perhe ja säihkyvä uusi Porsche autotallissa. Irtisanomiset ajavat Bobbyn ja hänen ystävänsä kadulle, jolloin heidän pitää määritellä itsensä uudestaan ihmisinä, aviomiehinä ja isinä. Ehkä se, jota Bobby joskus kutsui "työelämäksi", muuttuu pian oikeaksi elämäksi?

programme.title: Conviction
programme.desc: Bettyn veli tuomitaan murhasta, jolloin alkaa 18 vuoden taistelu järjestelmää vastaan. Betty uskoo veljensä syyttömyyteen, joten hän alkaa opiskella oikeustiedettä voidakseen puolustaa veljeään oikeudessa!

programme.title: Griffin & Phoenix
programme.desc: Kun Griffin saa kuulla, että hänellä on kuolemaan johtava sairaus, hän päättää ottaa kohtalonsa omiin käsiinsä ja elää täysillä loppuun asti. Hän tapaa Phoenixin ja aikaa myöten rakastuu tähän, mutta myös Phoenixilla on salaisuus...

programme.title: The Duchess
programme.desc: Kronikka 1700-luvun aristokraatin, Devonshiren herttuattaren Georgianan, elämästä. Häntä kunnioitettiin hänen ylellisestä poliittisesta ja henkilökohtaisesta elämästään.

programme.title: From Time to Time
programme.desc: Kummittava aavetarina, joka kattaa kaksi maailmaa, yli vuosisadan erolla. Kun 13-vuotias Tolly saa selville, että hän voi salaperäisesti matkustaa näiden kahden välillä, hän aloittaa seikkailun, joka paljastaa sukupolvien ajan haudatut perheen salaisuudet.

programme.title: Sommersby
programme.desc: Richard Gere ja Oscar-voittaja Jodie Foster tähdittävät romanttista tarinaa miehestä, joka palaa Amerikan sisällissodasta muuttuneena miehenä. Seitsemän vuotta on kulunut siitä, kun Jack Sommersby (Gere) lähti sotaan, joka on päättynyt jo kaksi vuotta sitten. Hänen vaimonsa Laurel (Foster) on jäänyt heidän maatilalleen ja on nyt kihloissa. Sommersbyn palatessa hän päättää kihlauksensa välittömästi jatkaakseen suhdetta aviomieheensä, joka oli aiemmin väkivaltainen, mutta nyt kiltti, hellä ja menestyvä. Sommersby ja hänen vaimonsa jakavat kuitenkin miehen menneisyydestä salaisuuden, joka paljastuessaan järkyttää koko yhteisöä.

programme.title: The Shack
programme.desc: Menestysromaaniin perustuva The Shack vie meidät isän kiehtovalle henkiselle matkalle. Perhetragediasta selviytynyt Mack Phillips vajoaa syvään masennukseen ja alkaa epäillä vakaimpia uskomuksiaan. Kesken uskonkriisin hän saa salaperäisen kirjeen, joka johdattaa hänet hylättyyn majaan kaukana erämaassa. Majalla hän tapaa kolme ventovierasta ihmistä, joita johtaa nainen. Tämän kohtaamisen kautta Mack löytää tärkeitä totuuksia, jotka mullistavat hänen käsityksensä kokemastaan tragediasta ja muuttavat hänen elämänsä lopullisesti.

programme.title: 10 Years
programme.desc: Kenestä tuli lihava? Kenestä tuli rikas? Kenestä tuli kaunis ja kuka pysyi entisenlaisena? Channing Tatum, Rosario Dawson ja Chris Pratt ovat kärkinimiä railakkaassa luokkakokouksessa, jossa omaksutaan vanhat roolit, rakkaussuhteet saavat uutta tulta alleen ja vanhat luurangot kaivetaan kaapeista. Kymmenen vuotta onkulunut, mutta jotkin asiat eivät koskaan muutu!

programme.title: Detroit
programme.desc: Elokuvien The Hurt Locker ja Zero Dark Thirty Oscar®-palkittu ohjaaja tarjoilee otteessaan pitävän, riipaisevan tarinan Yhdysvaltain rotumellakoiden synkimmistä hetkistä, jotka ravistelivat Detroitia kesällä 1967.

programme.title: Free State of Jones
programme.desc: Yhdysvaltain sisällissotaan sijoittuvan draaman pääroolissa nähdään Oscar-voittaja Matthew McConaughey. Newton Knight (McConaughey) palaa Mississippiin ja perustaa muiden sotakarkureiden sekä naisten ja pakoon päässeiden orjien kanssa vallankumousliikkeen. Yhtenä rintamana kapinalliset nousevat paikallista, korruptoitunutta etelävaltioiden hallintoa vastaan.

programme.title: Elegy
programme.desc: David Kepesh on arvostettu yliopiston professori, jonka maailma järkkyy, kun hänen luennoilleen ilmestyy kaunis Consuela Castillo. Consuelan kauneus ajaa professorin himon ja omistushalun pyörteeseen, jollaista hän ei ole aiemmin kokenut. Mutkikas rakkaustarina saa alkunsa. Perustuu Pulitzer-palkitun Philip Rothin teokseen.

programme.title: The Duchess
programme.desc: Kronikka 1700-luvun aristokraatin, Devonshiren herttuattaren Georgianan, elämästä. Häntä kunnioitettiin hänen ylellisestä poliittisesta ja henkilökohtaisesta elämästään.

programme.title: To The Wonder
programme.desc: Nuori kirjailija Neil on särkenyt sydämensä Ranskassa ja hän kääntyy uuden valittunsa puoleen kotikylässään Oklahomassa. Välimeren romanssi hiipuu, eikä Neil osaa valita eurooppalaisen rakkaansa, tai menneisyyden ihastuksen väliltä. Neil ei ole ainoa joka ei osaa valita. Rakkaus on jälleenmuuttamassa tai tuhoamassa viattomien ihmisten elämän ikiajoiksi.

programme.title: From Time to Time
programme.desc: Kummittava aavetarina, joka kattaa kaksi maailmaa, yli vuosisadan erolla. Kun 13-vuotias Tolly saa selville, että hän voi salaperäisesti matkustaa näiden kahden välillä, hän aloittaa seikkailun, joka paljastaa sukupolvien ajan haudatut perheen salaisuudet.

programme.title: Beatrix Potter
programme.desc: Hän on ihastuttanut monia sukupolvia, mutta hänen elämänsä on ollut salaisuus. Tähän saakka. Beatrix Potter on 30-vuotias sinkkunainen aikana, jolloin naisen kunnioitettavin tehtävä on mennä hyviin naimisiin. Kukaan, ei edes Beatrixin oma perhe, ymmärrä sitä, että Beatrix haluaa mieluummin piirtää ja kertoa tarinoita eläimistä. Kaikki menee pieleen, kun Beatrix tapaa kokemattoman kustantajan Norman Waynen, joka rakastuu korviaan myöten niin Beatrixin ainutlaatuisiin tarinoihin kuin itse Beatrixiinkin. Beatrix joutuu mahdottomaan tilanteeseen, jossa hänen pitää irrottautua perheen tukahduttavasta otteesta.

programme.title: Mothers and Daughters
programme.desc: Korkealla Manhattanin yläpuolella trendikäs ja onnellinen sinkkutyttö Rigby Gray kurkistelee naapureiden asuntoihin ja elämään. Hän piileskelee turvallisesti kameran pitkän linssin takana eikä tiedä, että hänen elämänsä on muuttumassa lopullisesti. Rigbyn otokset muiden elämästä heräävät eloon risteävissä tarinoissa, joissa äiti-lapsisuhteet esiintyvät kaikissa muodoissaan. Huomaamme, että siskot ja tuntemattomat, kämppikset ja rakastajat, jopa painajaismaiset anopit voivat olla mitä rakastettavimpia äitihahmoja.

programme.title: Night Train to Lisbon
programme.desc: Sveitsiläinen professori Raimund Gregorius hylkää luennot ja tiukan elämän lähteäkseen jännittävälle seikkailulle, joka vie hänet matkalle oman sisimpänsä syvyyksiin.

programme.title: Teen Spirit
programme.desc: Rikkinäisessä perheessä kasvanut 17-vuotias Violet (Fanning) unelmoi pop-tähteydestä ja paosta pienestä englantilaisesta kotikylästään. Toivoa hänelle tuo kansallinen laulukilpailu Teen Spirit ja epätavallinen mentori, joka opettaa häntä laulamaan sydämestään. Tie menestykseen on kuitenkin täynnä vaaroja ja houkutuksia. Violetin on voitettava epävarmuutensa uskaltaakseen olla oma itsensä ja päästäkseen lopulta loistamaan.

programme.title: Griffin & Phoenix
programme.desc: Kun Griffin saa kuulla, että hänellä on kuolemaan johtava sairaus, hän päättää ottaa kohtalonsa omiin käsiinsä ja elää täysillä loppuun asti. Hän tapaa Phoenixin ja aikaa myöten rakastuu tähän, mutta myös Phoenixilla on salaisuus...

programme.title: Boychoir
programme.desc: Stet, ongelmallinen ja vihainen 11-vuotias orpo pienestä texasilaisesta kaupungista, päätyy poikakuorokouluun itärannikolla yksinhuoltajaäitinsä kuoleman jälkeen. Täysin poissaolevana hän joutuu älyntaistoon vaativan kuoronjohtajan kanssa, joka tunnistaa nuoren pojan ainutlaatuisen lahjakkuuden ja kannustaa tätä löytämään luovan sydämensä ja sielunsa musiikista.

programme.title: Bekas
programme.desc: 1990-luvun alussa, Saddam Husseinin hallinto painostaa Irakin kurdialuetta. Kaksi koditonta kurdipoikaanäkee Teräsmiehen kaupungin ensimmäisessä elokuvateatterissa ja päättää lähteä Amerikkaan.Päästääkseen sinne he tarvitsevat passit, rahaa ja paljon onnea. Vaikka heillä ei ole mitään näistä, healoittavat silti matkan, joka vie heitä kohti unelmaa Amerikasta.Elokuva on Karzan Kaderin esikoisohjaus ja kahden veljeksen rooleissa nähdään Sarwar Fazil ja Zamand Taha.

programme.title: Walking With The Enemy
programme.desc: Pinchas Rosenbaumin tositarinan innoittama elokuva Walking with the Enemy sijoittuu toisen maailmansodan viimeisiin kuukausiin. Natsit ovat yrittäneet epätoivoisesti toimeenpanna syytteiltä tähän asti välttyneiden unkarinjuutalaisten kansanmurhaa, kunnes kuningaskunnan valtionhoitaja Horthy pakotetaan eroamaan Hitlerin ja Eichmannin tieltä.

programme.title: In Tranzit
programme.desc: Toisen maailmansodan päätyttyä joukko saksalaisia sotavankeja lähetetään leningradilaiselle vankileirille. Leirin naistyöntekijät vihaavat heidän miehensä ja poikansa tappaneita saksalaisia yli kaiken ja valmistautuvat nyt kostoon.

programme.title: Suffragette
programme.desc: Suffragette on huippunäyttelijöidenkannattelema, ylistetty draama brittiläistensuffragettien eli naisten äänioikeuttaajaneen liikkeen toiminnasta1910-luvun Britanniassa. Elokuvan pääroolissa loistaa Carey Mulligan (Inside Llewyn Davis, Drive). Hän on peloton ja oikeudentajuinen Maud, josta tulee nousevan naisliikkeenkantava voima. Maailman muuttaminenvaatii äärimmäisiä keinoja, janiitä nämä naiset eivät epäröi käyttää.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.sub-title: S00 : E01 GLORY Heavyweight Grand Prix 2024
programme.desc: 3 wins to come out on top, who's it going to be? Rico Verhoeven, Levi Rigters, Tarik Osaro, Benjamin Adegbuyi, Sofian Laidouni, Uku Jurjendal, Bahram Rajabzadeh, and Nabil Khachab pair up and throw down for the GLORY Heavyweight Grand Prix, an 8-man 1-night heavyweight tournament for the ages.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: A Champ vs. Champ superfight takes place in the main event as GLORY welterweight world champion Chico Kwasi (43-5, 23 KO) puts his title on the line against GLORY lightweight world champ Tyjani Beztati (27-4, 9 KO). In the co-main event, Donovan Wisse (21-1, 10 KO) aims to defend his GLORY middleweight world championship for a fifth time when he welcomes the challenge of top German Sergej Braun (44-13, 27 KO).

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: In the main event, ‘The King of Kickboxing’ Rico Verhoeven put his GLORY world heavyweight title on the line against number one contender ‘The Prince’ Levi Rigters in a hotly anticipated rematch from their GLORY Grand Prix final earlier this year. GLORY light heavyweight world champion Tarik Khbabez will collide with Donegi Abena in a trilogy fight to end their heated rivalry in the co-main event.
