programme.title: The Moody Blues - Days of Future Passed Live
programme.desc: To celebrate the album's 50th anniversary, The Moody Blues brought it to life in front of a lively Toronto-based crowd in July 2017.

programme.title: The Killers - Live at Rock Am Ring
programme.desc: Rock Am Ring (Nürburgring), Rock Im Park (Nuremberg) is a music festival that takes place annually at the Nürburgring Race Track in western Germany. Featuring The Killers.

programme.title: Justin Bieber - Live at Madison Square Garden
programme.desc: The film follows the pop star Justin Bieber during 10 days counting down to his performance at Madison Square Garden. It also includes footage from his My World Tour, interviews with family and friends, a visit to his original hometown in Canada, and some of the story and videos of his childhood.

programme.title: Beck - Austin City Limits
programme.desc: The Austin City Limits Music Festival is an annual music festival that takes place at Zilker Park in Austin, Texas. The festival features more than 130 bands on eight stages for three days.

programme.title: Rush - The Rise Of Kings
programme.desc: From Rush's early days playing in the bars of Toronto to their epic success on American stages; tracing the band's journey through hard rock, progressive rock, and heavy metal in the 1970s.

programme.title: AC/DC - Circus Krone
programme.desc: Filmed at the world famous Circus Krone in Munich, this AC/DC concert from June 17, 2003 features standout performances of Rock N Roll Damnation and What's Next To The Moon and more.

programme.title: John Mayall - 70th Birthday Concert
programme.desc: Liverpools Kings Dock on July 19 2003 was the venue for a long awaited and much anticipated reunion between Eric Clapton and John Mayall And the Bluesbreakers. The occasion was both a celebration of John Mayalls 70th year and a fundraiser for Unicef. Also invited to the party were former Bluesbreaker and Rolling Stone Mick Taylor and veteran trombonist Chris Barber. If youre a lover of the blues it doesnt get much better than this. The show ran for around two and a half hours and the film is now presented here in its entirety for the first time.

programme.title: Haim - Live at Main Square Festival 2013
programme.desc: Watch the performance of Haim live at the Main Square Festival on July 5th, 2013.

programme.title: Eric Clapton And Steve Winwood - Eric Clapton And Steve Winwood - Live from MSG
programme.desc: History rocked and rock made history during a sold-out three-gig stand at Madison Square Garden in late February 2008 when icons Eric Clapton and Steve Winwood performed a concert together for the first time since their all-too-brief days in the legendary Blind Faith in 1969. Whether they will ever team again is unknown. But with Eric Clapton and Steve Winwood Live From Madison Square Garden fans everywhere are able to experience the sound and the glory of a performance on that famous stage by two of rock's greatest artists.

programme.title: Florence And The Machine - Austin City Limits
programme.desc: The Austin City Limits Music Festival is an annual music festival that takes place at Zilker Park in Austin, Texas. The festival features more than 130 bands on eight stages for three days.

programme.title: Guns N' Roses - Live From The O2 Arena London
programme.desc: Watch this mega-production of Guns N’ Roses performing live at the O2 Arena to its fans singing and vibrating to each song. Includes; Paradise City, Sweet Child O’ Mine, November Rain and many more.

programme.title: Seal - Live at Soundstage
programme.desc: Seals one-of-a-kind soaring, husky baritone voice is perfect for any genre. Hes delighted fans and earned critical acclaim while staying true to classic, honest songwriting in his remarkable two-decade career. And now, hes done it again with the release of his exceptional sixth studio album Soul. Together with legendary music producer David Foster, Seal adds his signature touch to some of the best soul songs ever created. In a stunning performance, Seal evokes an era when music vividly captured emotion and romance. Joined by Foster, as well as a choir and string section, Seal takes on Ann Pebbles I Cant Stand the Rain, Sam Cookes A Change Is Gonna Come, and Harold Melvin and the Blue Notes If You Dont Know Me By Now. Tune in and catch more timeless favorites and hits like Kiss From a Rose.

programme.title: Billy Talent - Live At Festival Rock Am Ring
programme.desc: Rock Am Ring (Nürburgring), Rock Im Park (Nuremberg) is a music festival that takes place annually at the Nürburgring Race Track in western Germany. Featuring Billy Talent.

programme.title: Imagine Dragons - Live At The Moody Theater
programme.desc: Filmed at The Moody Theater, Texas, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Classic Imagine Dragons featuring unforgettable version of their hits: 'Demons', 'Radioactive' and many more.

programme.title: Kylie Minogue - Live in London
programme.desc: Two hours of classic Kylie, capturing the energy, grandeur and extravagance of the massively acclaimed Aphrodite: Les Folies tour. Filmed at Kylie's triumphant O2 Arena show in London, this concert film was produced using a lavishly hi-tech multi-camera shoot affording the viewer a spectacular experience from start to finish. The 2-hour show proved to be one of the most elaborate and extravagant productions ever staged by a pop performer, a multi-million dollar visual and musical feast, that delighted critics and fans alike wherever it played. Now Kylie's fans can re-live the experience with this amazing 2-hour document, which includes all of her best-known modern hits- Can t Get You Out Of My Head, Spinning Around- as well as her four Billboard Club smashes from 2010's acclaimed Aphrodite album including All The Lovers and Get Outta My Way.

programme.title: Oasis - Live at Wembley Arena 2008
programme.desc: Filmed at Wembley Arena, London, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Classic Oasis featuring unforgettable version of their hits: 'Champagne Supernova', 'Don’t Look Back In Anger', 'Rock N Roll Star' and many more.

programme.title: a-ha - Unplugged: Summer Solstice
programme.desc: The first a-ha MTV Unplugged Concert ever. The album “MTV Unplugged – Summer Solstice” is being released including a very special LIVE experience.Share the impressive unplugged concert with a-ha in front of astonishing scenery on the picturesque island of Giske, located on the Norwegian coastline.Experience the concert including some hit singles like “Take On Me”, “The Sun Always Shines On TV”, and “The Living Daylights” as well as two new Songs.

programme.title: Alabama and Friends - Live at the Ryman
programme.desc: Join superstar band Alabama in a once in a lifetime concert event, recorded at the historic Ryman Auditorium, featuring on stage collaborations with country's biggest stars: Luke Bryan, Jason Aldean, Trisha Yearwood, Florida Georgia Line, Jamey Johnson and the Eli Young Band. Experience timeless tunes 'Tennessee River', 'Love In The First Degree', 'I'm In A Hurry (And Don't Know Why)', 'My Home's In Alabama', and more.

programme.title: WALK THE MOON - Live in London 2012
programme.desc: Filmed at Roundhouse, London, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Walk the Moon performs their hits including Shiver Shiver, Next in Line, Anna Sun and many more.

programme.title: Snow Patrol - Live At Somerset House
programme.desc: With their third album, 'Final Straw', selling a cool 1.5 million in the UK in its year of release, Snow Patrol's reputation as a remarkable band remains intact. 'Live At Somerset House' reveals why the band is praised for delivering fantastic live performances. It also places them at one of London's most gorgeous settings which complements the band's distinctive and provocative sound perfectly. Performing live for the first time with a string section, this amazing Snow Patrol concert, features all the key hits including 'Run', 'Spitting Games', 'Chocolate' and a blistering version of 'Tiny Little Fractures'.

programme.title: Deep Purple - Live in Verona
programme.desc: Filmed in the spectacular surroundings of the Arena di Verona, a Roman amphitheatre originally built in 30 AD, this concert from the summer of 2011 sees Deep Purple joined on stage by a full symphony orchestra for performances of all their classic tracks.

programme.title: Tom Petty And The Heartbreakers - Live at Soundstage
programme.desc: Filmed live from the Vic Theatre, Chicago, Illinois, USA in April 2003 for the 'Soundstage' TV series.

programme.title: Noel Gallagher - Live in London 2012
programme.desc: ITunes Festival, is an annual music festival that takes place over a month in London. Sponsored by Apple Inc., it had its first edition in 2007.

programme.title: Foo Fighters - Austin City Limits
programme.desc: The acclaimed rock group Foo Fighters returns to the ACL stage to perform some of their biggest hits, including Times Like These, My Hero, The Teacher, The Best of You, Everlong, White Limo, This Is a Call and All My Life.

programme.title: Velvet Revolver - Live in Houston
programme.desc: A concert filmed in Houston, Texas in 2005 while on tour for Velvet Revolver's best-selling and Grammy-winning debut album Contraband.

programme.title: David Guetta - Live in London 2012
programme.desc: Filmed at Roundhouse, London, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Classic David Guetta featuring unforgettable version of his hits: Without You, Titanium, One Love and many more…

programme.title: Gwen Stefani - This is What The Truth Feels Like Tour
programme.desc: This is What The Truth Feels Like is a Gwen Stefani tour made to publicize her album, with the same name. The tour was done in the United States and Canada in 2016.

programme.title: Lana Del Rey - Live in London 2012
programme.desc: Born to Die is the second album by singer-songwriter Lana Del Rey, and the first to be officially released on January 27, 2012 and that would lead to global success; In countries such as the United Kingdom the album was the best selling of that year, that recognition made her a guest of honor in one of the most popular London festivals iTunes Festival, where she would open the awe of all attendees on the night of September 25 2012 at the Roundhouse in the city of London.

programme.title: Rush - The Rise Of Kings
programme.desc: From Rush's early days playing in the bars of Toronto to their epic success on American stages; tracing the band's journey through hard rock, progressive rock, and heavy metal in the 1970s.

programme.title: BTK: A Killer Among Us
programme.desc: Serial killer BTK terrorised Wichita, Kansas for 30 years until his capture in 2005. Investigators, victims' families and his own daughter reveal how they were affected.

programme.title: Still A Mystery
programme.desc: Their evenings begin as fun celebrations with friends but they end in murder. With disturbing evidence, terrifying theories, and demands for justice, police aim to solve the mystery of how two young partygoers are murdered.

programme.title: Evil Lives Here: Shadows Of Death
programme.desc: In 1974, 17-year-old Carla Walker is kidnapped. For 45 years the case goes unsolved, and no one knows that the person responsible is hiding in plain sight.

programme.title: Raharemontti
programme.desc: Tiina on yksinhuoltaja, jonka taloustilanne on kireä ja kaikki raha, mikä tulee, myös menee. Neurovähemmistöön kuuluminen tuo omat haasteensa Tiinan taloudenhallintaan ja häntä huolettaa varsinkin mahdolliset yllätyskulut. Tilannetta auttavat ratkomaan talouden asiantuntija Joni Rintamaa, psykologi Karoliina Mellanen ja juontaja Jaana Pelkonen.

programme.title: Tankar och toner från Kanal 10
programme.desc: Sommaren 2021 möttes några av Sveriges duktigaste kristna sångare kring den andliga sångskatten i två uppskattade konserter. Nu kan du också vara med och sjunga hemma vid tv:n.

programme.title: Gaither - Ett ovärderligt musikarv
programme.desc: Få personer har haft en så djup inverkan på den kristna musikvärlden som Bill och Gloria Gaither. I över 60 år har de skrivit musik som berört generationer över hela världen och som har undgått få i kyrkans värld. I detta hyllningsprogram till Bill och Gloria Gaither träffar Matt och Laurie Crouch paret i deras hemstad Alexandria, Indiana, för en exklusiv intervju med framförallt Bill. Lyssna också till andra kända musikartister som ger sin personliga hyllning. Programmet är textat till svenska.

programme.title: Aril Edvardsen Classics - Bibelns GOG-krig
programme.desc: Aril Edvardsen är sannolikt en av Nordens mest inflytelserika andliga ledare genom det missionsarbete han fick vara med och bygga upp. Från enkla förhållande på norska sörlandet tar han kallelsen ut i hela världen och oerhörda skaror har tagit emot Jesus Kristus genom Arils förkunnelse och missionens olika evangelister. Här får du ta del av Arils förkunnelse i samband med konferenser i Sarons Dal och på andra platser i Norge. Textat till svenska.

programme.title: Du tar dig igenom med Max Lucado
programme.desc: I denna serie tar bästsäljande författaren och förkunnaren Max Lucado med oss till Bibelns berättelse om Josef. Utifrån hans liv kan vi lära oss att det finns en väg framåt, även i de mörkaste och mest hopplösa perioderna av livet.

programme.title: Good Life - River Church Finland
programme.desc: In the beginning God created the world and saw it was good. Sin corrupted everything but through the redemptive work of Jesus we have an access to God’s original intent and good life that He has for mankind. In this series pastors Tomi and Sanna are teaching various principles of the word of God containing life and blessing. Tomi and Sanna Lehto are lead pastors of River Church Finland And River Bible School in Helsinki. Their vision and passion is for every ear to hear the good news of the gos

programme.title: Vem skrev sången? - J.A. Hultman och Lydia Lithell
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet möter vi två tonsättare, J.A. Hultman och Lydia Lithell.Johannes Alfred Hultman mötte Jesus som 16-åring och skrev därefter mängder med sånger som han turnerade med. Han kallades solskenssångaren och en av anledningarna var att hans sånger ofta var positiva. Hans mest kända sång är Tack min Gud för vad som varit.Lydia Lithell var organist, sångförfattare och kompositör och hon har satt djupa avtryck i kristenheten och utanför med sina sånger. Bland sångerna märks Det enda jag vet och Jag har hört om en stad ovan molnen.I detta musikprogram berättar Mikael Järlestrand om några av tidernas mest legendariska tonsättare och framför sånger av dem tillsammans med ⁣pianist Marcus Ander.

programme.desc: I detta program samtalar Britta Bolmenäs med psykologen och författaren Alf B Svensson om allt som har med relationer att göra. Det svåraste men också det bästa i livet. Vad gör jag om jag inte förstår mig på mitt barns intressen? Det är lätt att vi vill leva ut våra drömmar genom våra barn. I detta program pratar Britta och Alf även om skillnaden mellan kvinnor och män och att alla människor har olika kärleksspråk och att vi måste fråga varandra, när känner du dig mest älskad?

programme.title: En vandring genom Romarbrevet - del 14
programme.desc: I denna serie tar Olof Edsinger med oss på en vandring genom Romarbrevet.

programme.title: Ett Heligt Prästerskap Del 8
programme.desc: Cherstin och Esther samtalar om vårt tankeliv och Bibelns råd om hur vi ska hantera våra tankar.Ett Heligt Prästerskap är programserien som ger oss bibliska tips på hur vi kan leva ett radikalt Jesusliv. I denna programserie pratar vi om många olika saker men kommer hela tiden tillbaka till vikten av att läsa Bibeln och att göra aktiva val på livets alla områden. Detta för att kunna leva helöverlåtna liv enligt den plan som Gud har för sin skapelse. Du får tips på allt från hur du kan få ett fungerande andaktsliv till de val du behöver göra för att leva med den moraliska ryggrad och styrka som den Helige Ande vill bistå oss med för att kunna välja det rätta, goda och sanna i varje situation. Vi berör även sådant som hur vi ska hantera våra känslor och vårt tal så att det behagar Herren. Detta och mycket mer samtalar Cherstin Lindberg och Esther Nilsson om. Ytterst handlar det om att arbeta på vår helgelse, så att vi kan vara de präster som Jesus har kallat oss till att vara, för att utbreda Guds rike på jorden.

programme.title: Fråga Lund
programme.desc: I säsongspremiären svarar läkaren Henrik på om låg puls är lika med större risk att hamna i fängelse? Evolutionsbiologen Jessica reder ut om vilda djur kan ha favoriträtter och rymdfysikern Gabriella får med Robin på ett riktigt snurrigt bollspel. Medverkande: Robin Paulsson, Gabriella Stenberg Wieser, Gunnar Wetterberg, Jessica Abbott, Ulf Ellervik och Henrik Widegren.

programme.title: Världens natur
programme.desc: Sötvatten är både livets förutsättning och många djurs livsmiljö. När skyfallen dränker Costa Ricas regnskogar samlas trädgrodorna för att leka uppe på grenarna. Där läggs äggen på ett blad och när de kläcks ramlar ynglen ner i en perfekt barnkammare.

programme.title: Så gjordes Planet Earth III
programme.desc: Följ med bakom kulisserna och ta del av vilket arbete som krävs för att skapa en av världens mest spektakulära naturserier.

programme.title: På resa i Medelhavet
programme.desc: Den kroatiska ön Hvar har sex verk på Unescos världsarvslista. Den är också känd för sina lavendelfält och sitt unika spetsbroderi, likväl som lyx och vackra stränder.

programme.title: Människans bästa vän
programme.desc: I Louisiana, USA, har Denny blivit vän med en sumpbäver. Efter att ha sett bäverns familj dödas av en bil, kunde Denny inte lämna den lilla ungen utan tog hand om honom. Han kämpade till och med i domstol för att få ett unikt tillstånd att behålla honom. På andra sidan Atlanten på den engelska landsbygden tar Martin hand om en blind igelkott vid namn Terry, efter att ha lämnat sitt liv som bankman för att rehabilitera skadade igelkottar. I Sydafrika förbereder Belinda en grön markatta vid namn Cosima för ett liv i det vilda, medan Claire i sitt hem tar hand om en serval - en vildkatt som blivit hennes ständiga följeslagare.

programme.title: Historien om Sverige
programme.desc: En tid i pestens grymma skugga följer, fylld av blodiga uppror och ond bråd död. Många ger sig in i maktkampen om Sverige och den svenska tronen men det är bara en som kommer att lyckas, och för att göra det krävs både list och hänsynslöshet. Simon J Berger är seriens berättare.

programme.title: Historiskt eftersnack
programme.desc: Hade Sverige blivit detsamma utan Gustav Vasa? Är gotlänningarna fortfarande arga över sveket vid ringmuren när den gutiska bondearmén slaktades av Valdemar Atterdags gäng? Historiskt eftersnack reder ut känslor och fakta med hjälp av Bo Eriksson, docent i historia och Joel Halldorf, professor i kyrkohistoria. Dessutom bedömer komikern Emma Mohlin humorvärdet i medeltida vitsar.

programme.title: Det hände här
programme.desc: Programledaren Anders Lundin och historikerna Bo Eriksson, Anna Maria Forssberg och Lisa Hellman besöker Habo i Västergötland. Under tre dagar ska de hitta varsin historia innan de samlar invånarna och avslöjar vad de hittat.

programme.title: Antikens riken
programme.desc: I en oförutsägbar värld måste våra forntida makter lägga grunden till sina samhällen för att visa sin styrka och skydda sitt folk. Vilka kommer att bygga upp sitt land till ärans höjder?

programme.title: Vilda västern
programme.desc: Kapitlet om vilda västern avslutas när USA:s land sträcker sig över hela kontinenten, men nationen bär på ärren efter en systematisk etnisk rensning av ursprungsbefolkningar.

programme.title: Världens historia
programme.desc: Kurt Kiesinger är 1960 Västtysklands förbundskansler. Han var nazist och arbetade nära nazisthöjdaren Ribbentrop under kriget. Många nazister har inte fått något straff utan lever som vanligt i det tyska samhället. För många, som trott att de klarat sig, väntar dock domen. Den mest jagade, läkaren Josef Mengele, mer känd som Dödsängeln från Auschwitz, är fortfarande på fri fot.

programme.title: Vilda västern
programme.desc: Kapitlet om vilda västern avslutas när USA:s land sträcker sig över hela kontinenten, men nationen bär på ärren efter en systematisk etnisk rensning av ursprungsbefolkningar.

programme.title: Övergivna byggnader
programme.desc: I New Jersey finns en plats där sociala orättvisor hotar att nå bristningsgränsen. I Polen står ett forna kejserligt fäste som senare användes som ett kraftfullt propagandaverktyg i USA. På den engelska landsbygden ligger ett lantligt tillhåll som en gång gav skydd åt radikala flyktingar. Och i Namibia finns en isolerad utpost, byggd på förlorade rikedomar. Del 6 av 8.

programme.title: Antikens riken
programme.desc: I en oförutsägbar värld måste våra forntida makter lägga grunden till sina samhällen för att visa sin styrka och skydda sitt folk. Vilka kommer att bygga upp sitt land till ärans höjder?

programme.title: Destination Asien
programme.desc: I kölden på Himalayas sluttningar har de fått platta nosar och tyr sig till varandra för att hålla värmen. På Thailands stränder har de lärt sig att öppna skaldjur med stenar. Aporna i Asien är lika varierade som djurlivet i övrigt på den väldiga kontinenten.

programme.title: På resa i Medelhavet
programme.desc: Välkomna till Napoleon Bonapartes födelseplats Korsika. Här finns 60 mil av vidunderlig kust och majestätiska berg. Vi möter en bankman som sadlat om till bagare och får lära oss både vad den korsikanska revolutionen och den annalkande kastanjesäsongen betyder för öns invånare.

programme.title: Världens natur: Badlands
programme.desc: I hjärtat av mellanvästra USA finns ett kargt landskap där svartsvansade präriehundar, prärieugglor och bisonoxar kämpar för att överleva.

programme.title: Alone Australien
programme.desc: Överlevnad i den tasmanska vildmarken är bara en del av utmaningen för deltagarna. Den känslomässiga isoleringen visar sig bli övermäktig för somliga.

programme.title: Resfeber: Turismens pris
programme.desc: Turism är en industri värd tio tusen miljarder dollar - och den växer hela tiden. Men vart går alla pengar? Får du valuta för pengarna? Och gynnar det dina värddestinationer?

programme.title: Studio natur
programme.desc: Dör myggor när de sugit blod och varför sover koalor så mycket? Experterna är som vanligt Bent Christensen, Kristina Snuttan Sundell och Marie Dacke. Programledare: Linda Olofsson.

programme.title: Arktiset vedet
programme.desc: Keski-Suomen keskikesä ja koskien kuohu. Mukana olympiavoittajat Teemu Hartikainen ja Markus Granlund, sekä retkikunnan päämies Juhani Henriksson.

programme.title: Barnwood Builders
programme.desc: Mark Bowe ja hänen ammattitaitoinen käsityöläisporukkansa hyödyntävät uusiokäytössä vanhoja latoja ja mökkejä. He käyttävät puuta ja muita materiaaleja upeiden, nykyaikaisten kotien luomiseen.

programme.title: Rivalry in Music – Furtwängler vs. Toscanini
programme.desc: Two men without whom the profession of conductor would not be what it is today. Two men who couldn't be more different from each other: Arturo Toscanini and Wilhelm Furtwängler. The former was rigorously faithful to the musical score, the latter conducted with radical subjectivity. In 1931 they both conducted at the Bayreuth Festival – for the first and last time. Soon the polite rivalry turned into bitter enmity. Both men were forced to take a stand on the regimes in their respective countries – and chose radically different paths. Toscanini, the dictator, bravely challenged Mussolini; Furtwängler, a conservative, meanwhile proclaimed that art is always apolitical and reluctantly made a pact with the Nazis. The documentary not only opens up the different musical universes of the two great conductors by retracing their careers in Milan, Bayreuth and New York, but also raises a question that is more topical than ever: what has art to do with politics?Subtitles available for this program with your remote control

programme.desc: Floridassa tallentui videolle harvinainen tapahtuma meripetoeläinten välillä: härkähait hyökkäsivät isovasarahain kimppuun. Tohtori Heithaus ja haiasiantuntijoiden tiimi käynnistävät tutkimuksen. He selvittävät, mitä tapahtuu, kun nämä kaksi petoa kohtaa.

programme.title: Savannien valtiaat
programme.desc: Mmamotsen valta-asema on kääntänyt koko kuningaskunnan ylöslaisin. Perintö on nyt kiinni prinsessasta, jonka pitäisi nousta valtaan. Kun tulvavedet vetäytyvät, Dikeledi valmistelee pentunsa pakoon, mutta joutuu samalla ottamaan riskin ja astumaan vihollisen reviirille. Kahnaus Matahta-lauman kanssa saa Pulan keskittymään oleelliseen, kun se aloittaa kouluttamaan nuorta sissiään. Savage Kingdomissa avain valtaan on nuorten käsissä.

programme.title: Gepardien tie
programme.desc: Gepardit ovat hauraita kissoja, ja niitä on enää 7 000 jäljellä. Tämä on Immanin tarina. Se on siro naaras, jolla on neljä pentua, joiden kanssa se taivaltaa Maran alueella. Siellä on myös viiden uroksen ryhmä, ja pitääkseen pennut hengissä Immanin on välteltävä niitä. Ohjelman tekijät, Dereck ja Beverly Joubert, ovat tehneet kymmeniä ohjelmia kissoista, mutta eivät aikaisemmin gepardeista.

programme.title: Alaskan lentopelastajat
programme.desc: Hengenvaarallinen lasku. Tällä kertaa nähdään mm. vaarallisia laskeutumisia jäätiköille ja vuoristossa sijaitsevien puhelinmastojen korjauksia. Alaskan karussa luonnossa pärjäävät vain taitavimmat lentäjät. National Geographic Channel.

programme.title: Antarktis
programme.desc: Etelämantereella sekä ihmiset että eläimet sopeutuvat parhaansa mukaan maapallon vihamielisimpään ilmastoon. Tutkijamme keskittyvät tutkimukseensa hyisissä vesissä katsoakseen, kuinka ilmastonmuutos ja ihmisen toimet ovat vaikuttaneet merten ekosysteemiin. Ihmishenki on vaarassa, kun sitä ylläpitävä tekniikka pettää.

programme.title: Surf Series: South Africa
programme.desc: The Vic Bay Classic takes place in the winter months so expect the biggest swells and highest quality of surfing. Watch former CT contender fight for the win as the crowd cheers their local hero. The fight for the mens series winner gets even closer at this final event. Who will claim victory and take the overall series winnings in the season finale of the City Surf Series?

programme.title: H2O Racing: Aquabike World Championship
programme.desc: After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM-ABP H20 Racing Aquabike World Championship is the premier international Jet Ski competition that sees elite riders compete on cutting edge equipment in four categories: Runabout, Ski, Ski Ladies and Freestyle. The need for speed is demonstrated on this extreme water sport as athletes plough across the water.

programme.title: H2O Racing: Aquabike World Championship
programme.desc: After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM-ABP H20 Racing Aquabike World Championship is the premier international Jet Ski competition that sees elite riders compete on cutting edge equipment in four categories: Runabout, Ski, Ski Ladies and Freestyle. The need for speed is demonstrated on this extreme water sport as athletes plough across the water.

programme.title: Speed Catamarans GC32
programme.desc: Throughout the season, the four stops offered nail-biting action in breath taking venues that brought the best out of these dynamic and fast design foiling catamarans. The level of expectation and the anticipation was extremely high and both the organizers and the participants proved that it was worth waiting for the comeback. Let’s remember the most notable moments of what was a fascinating season full of top-level sailing battles in some crystal clear blue waters.

programme.title: Le Défi Azimut
programme.desc: The Défi Azimut is an atypical event in the offshore race world. It brings together the IMOCA class and gathers the skippers of the Vendée Globe and Lorient-based company Azimut. Combining performance, innovation and strategy, it provides the best level of sailing competition with a lot of friendliness.In this edition, the Défi Azimut brings together new boats as well as experienced Imocas to compete in racing mode for five days in Lorient. Every year, this festive event gathers nautical enthusiasts together just a few weeks before the start of the Vendee Globe race. Watch the race that prioritizes the human factor as the key value and that carries out collaborative projects bringing together people around the world with a passion for the sea.

programme.title: Discovering Rhodes
programme.desc: In this second episode, we will visit the historic and picturesque Mandraki Harbour before exploring the natural attractions of Butterfly Valley and Seven Springs. Rhodes is often known as the paradise island for windsurfers, so we will not miss the chance to see how it feels to be on a board out on the open water. Finally, we will visit the must-see archaeological sites that aren’t to be missed before leaving the island, the town and the Acropolis of Lindos.

programme.title: Atlantic Cup
programme.desc: Welcome back to this edition of the Atlantic Cup. It is time for the third and final leg of the competition, the inshore series. Dragon and Gryphon Solo 2 are tied for, and teams have added 4 extra crew, allowing them to push their boats around the tight courses in Naragannset Bay. Any mistake could be the difference between first and last. Who will become the winner in this edition?

programme.title: Wind Masters
programme.desc: Of Croatia’s 3,600 miles of glimmering coastline, the most famous stretch is its southernmost region: the Dalmatian Coast, where dramatic limestones cliffs rise from the deep and islands are scattered just offshore.​In Wind Masters, our team is set to explore the most popular sailing routes and the most beautiful places in the Croatian part of the Adriatic Sea. From the famous city of Dubrovnik, which is the most prominent tourist destination in the Mediterranean, to the beautiful island of Korcula, which will enchant your senses with its ancient history.​If Croatia have crept onto your holidays’ radar, Wind Masters is perfect for you. This series will offer you a complete Croatian experience. Watch it now on Nautical Channel.​

programme.title: Durban Extravaganza
programme.desc: Durban: a coastal city in eastern South Africa’s KwaZulu-Natal province known for its diverse influences and for hosting the Durban Extravaganza. The City of Durban and Durban Stars have brought the heat to the beautiful beachfront with the Surfing South Africa sanctioned Pro Surf Tour competition. Over 3 three days, the top 100 surfers gather in the South African city to participate in the hottest surfing competition of the African country.You can expect high-level competition with waves that are over 2-3 foot in Durban Extravaganza. Competing at the Bay of Plenty, surfers will surely dive in for plenty of action. A fanta-SEA for surf lovers!

programme.title: Discovering Symi
programme.desc: Welcome to Greece and the beautiful island of Symi in the middle of the Aegean Sea. Symi is part of the Dodecanese island chain, located about forty-one kilometers northwest of Rhodes, featuring fifty-eight-point one square kilometers of mountainous terrain. In this episode we will witness the beauty of Symi’s capital, Gialos, and its neighbouring district of Chorio.

programme.title: Sail-Ho
programme.desc: The Crikvenica Riviera is one of the most scenic parts of the Adriatic coast with a rich diversity of attractive beaches, green hinterland, a continental wooden area, a climate that provides perfect refreshment in the summer time and just the right amount of action-packed fun in the sun. Find out more in this episode of Sail-ho Croatia!

programme.title: Sail-Ho
programme.desc: Welcome, sailors! In this episode of Sail-ho Croatia we arrive to the incredibly beautiful, fragrant and action-packed island of Cres. The islands of Cres and Lošinj are connected to the ancient legend of Jason and the Argonauts in their search for the golden fleece aboard the Argo. Stick around to find out the best spots in these islands!

We will be making new friends that will be teaching us about their favourite music styles and, this close to the end, will our two protagonists be getting sentimental? programme.title: Sailing Documentary Show
programme.desc: Sailing boats have always come in different shapes and size. Whether if they are used for competition, fishing or recreational use, competition has always been at the heart of sport, pushing boundaries in technological advancements. The Extreme Sailing Series combines the top class sailing teams and the advanced innovations in technology, and watching the races becomes a thrill to spectators. With circuits that range through eight global events, the Extreme Sailing Series is breaking boundaries. Follow the journey of boats that are some of the fastest in production and that can reach speeds of just under 40 knots or almost 75 kilometres per hour.

programme.title: Sail-Ho
programme.desc: The island of Rab has a rich history and has been inhabited by numerous great personalities. The Romans named this place Felix Arba or Lucky, which actually means Happy island. With 30 sandy beaches, Rab is truly a happy island and its beauty has been recognized by tourists from around the world for almost 125 years.

programme.title: Sail-Ho
programme.desc: We begin our journey inside Sail-Ho at the most beautiful and magical old city: Dubrovnik. Home to many famous TV series due to its historical and beautiful landscape, we are ready to sail around the Elafiti islands and introduce you to the top quality wines of Pelješac peninsula.

programme.title: Chef On Board
programme.desc: Lapo is back on land for the Surf and Turf Season finale. He will be meeting the Tuscan Cowboys to learn about Tuscany’s beef industry as well as taking to the waters with a local fisherman to fish for sea urchins. On this final episode, Lapo is ready to give his all and prove himself worthy of his captain's approval. Will the Captain finally soften to Lapo?

programme.title: Exploring Italy's Tyrrhenian Coasts
programme.desc: In this series, we are going to discover the wonders of the Tyrrhenian coast. This area of Italy is full of marvelous landscapes and natural beauty. It's region is rich in culture and history, and full of ancient villages and imposing cities. We plan on embarking on this new adventure to unveil the best guarded secrets, the most impressive landscapes and get into the water to discover what water sports the area has to offer as well as what regattas dock in this coast. Follow us as we explore Italy's Tyrrhenian coast, now available on Nautical Channel.

With 30 sandy beaches, Rab is truly a happy island and its beauty has been recognized by tourists from around the world for almost 125 years.

programme.title: Sail-Ho
programme.desc: We begin our journey inside Sail-Ho at the most beautiful and magical old city: Dubrovnik. Home to many famous TV series due to its historical and beautiful landscape, we are ready to sail around the Elafiti islands and introduce you to the top quality wines of Pelješac peninsula.

programme.title: Wind Masters
programme.desc: Of Croatia’s 3,600 miles of glimmering coastline, the most famous stretch is its southernmost region: the Dalmatian Coast, where dramatic limestones cliffs rise from the deep and islands are scattered just offshore.​In Wind Masters, our team is set to explore the most popular sailing routes and the most beautiful places in the Croatian part of the Adriatic Sea. From the famous city of Dubrovnik, which is the most prominent tourist destination in the Mediterranean, to the beautiful island of Korcula, which will enchant your senses with its ancient history.​If Croatia have crept onto your holidays’ radar, Wind Masters is perfect for you. This series will offer you a complete Croatian experience. Watch it now on Nautical Channel.​

programme.title: Durban Extravaganza
programme.desc: Durban: a coastal city in eastern South Africa’s KwaZulu-Natal province known for its diverse influences and for hosting the Durban Extravaganza. The City of Durban and Durban Stars have brought the heat to the beautiful beachfront with the Surfing South Africa sanctioned Pro Surf Tour competition. Over 3 three days, the top 100 surfers gather in the South African city to participate in the hottest surfing competition of the African country.You can expect high-level competition with waves that are over 2-3 foot in Durban Extravaganza. Competing at the Bay of Plenty, surfers will surely dive in for plenty of action. A fanta-SEA for surf lovers!

programme.title: Discovering Rhodes
programme.desc: In this second episode, we will visit the historic and picturesque Mandraki Harbour before exploring the natural attractions of Butterfly Valley and Seven Springs. Rhodes is often known as the paradise island for windsurfers, so we will not miss the chance to see how it feels to be on a board out on the open water. Finally, we will visit the must-see archaeological sites that aren’t to be missed before leaving the island, the town and the Acropolis of Lindos.

programme.title: Discovering Symi
programme.desc: Welcome to Greece and the beautiful island of Symi in the middle of the Aegean Sea. Symi is part of the Dodecanese island chain, located about forty-one kilometers northwest of Rhodes, featuring fifty-eight-point one square kilometers of mountainous terrain. In this episode we will witness the beauty of Symi’s capital, Gialos, and its neighbouring district of Chorio.

programme.title: Speed Catamarans GC32
programme.desc: Throughout the season, the four stops offered nail-biting action in breath taking venues that brought the best out of these dynamic and fast design foiling catamarans. The level of expectation and the anticipation was extremely high and both the organizers and the participants proved that it was worth waiting for the comeback. Let’s remember the most notable moments of what was a fascinating season full of top-level sailing battles in some crystal clear blue waters.

programme.title: Le Défi Azimut
programme.desc: The Défi Azimut is an atypical event in the offshore race world. It brings together the IMOCA class and gathers the skippers of the Vendée Globe and Lorient-based company Azimut. Combining performance, innovation and strategy, it provides the best level of sailing competition with a lot of friendliness.In this edition, the Défi Azimut brings together new boats as well as experienced Imocas to compete in racing mode for five days in Lorient. Every year, this festive event gathers nautical enthusiasts together just a few weeks before the start of the Vendee Globe race. Watch the race that prioritizes the human factor as the key value and that carries out collaborative projects bringing together people around the world with a passion for the sea.

programme.title: Kite Masters
programme.desc: Welcome to Kite Masters!The series that flies you around the world, together with the very best athletes from one of the fastest, most extreme and stylish sports: kiteboarding. For some people kiteboarding is a hobby, for others it’s a performance, but for many it’s life.We bring the most passionate athletes experience inside the sport to the screen. We’ll take a look back over all the happenings earlier this season in the extreme world of kiteboarding, and the transformation of the sport on the road to Paris 2024.Follow these pro athletes on their journey to become the best in their fields and their evolution throughout the years. Now available, on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: H2O Racing: Aquabike World Championship
programme.desc: After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM-ABP H20 Racing Aquabike World Championship is the premier international Jet Ski competition that sees elite riders compete on cutting edge equipment in four categories: Runabout, Ski, Ski Ladies and Freestyle. The need for speed is demonstrated on this extreme water sport as athletes plough across the water.

programme.title: Ice Canoe Carnival Quebec
programme.desc: Rowing through icy currents in the cold is not for the faint of heart. However, every year competitors jump into their canoes to race in the Ice Canoe Carnival Quebec. The Canoe Race is a legendary competition that has been held since the Carnival's first edition. When the Québec Winter Carnival returned in 1955, ice canoe racing became once again an important annual event, and is now awaited by many in the Canadian city.Each year, several courageous teams compete in extremely freezing conditions a tumultuous ride along the St. Lawrence River between Quebec City and Levis. Find out which team will win against the cold and icy Canadian conditions!

programme.title: Rediscover North America
programme.desc: Six friends decide to cross 12 states on their canoe, embarking on the adventure of a lifetime. From the Gulf of Mexico to the Arctic Ocean, they battled against the current on the Mighty Mississippi, weathered ice and snow, crossed massive lakes, dodged shifting forest fires and shot challenging whitewater, all in a blasting total of 5200 miles.

Jos koet, että kehon ja mielen rauhoittaminen olisi paikallaan, tämä harjoitus sopii sinulle. Hengityksen kautta saa rauhoitettua hermostoa, mikä vaikuttaa koko kehossa vallitsevaan olotilaan. Voit siis kehoa rentouttamalla rentouttaa myös mieltäsi. Ota itsellesi mukava asento ja tule ottamaan mukava rentoutushetki, oman kehon tarpeita kuunnellen, arjen askareiden väliin.

programme.title: Il restauratore
programme.desc: Un militare verrà ucciso in un campo di addestramento: è il contatto con una vecchia spada ad allertare Basilio. Viene accusata del crimine la figlia di un colonnello, ma Basilio non è convinto che sia lei la colpevole e vuole vederci chiaro.

programme.title: Das Vermächtnis des geheimen Buches
programme.desc: Der Historiker und Schatzjäger Ben Gates bekommt einen neuen Hinweis, wo der geheimnisvolle Schatz der Tempelritter verborgen sein könnte. Mit seinem Kumpan Riley und Ex-Freundin Abigali macht sich Ben wieder auf die Suche. Doch auch der skrupellose Geschäftsmann Wilkinson ist hinter dem Schatz her. Nur wer in den Besitz des Geheimen Buches des US-Präsidenten gelangt, wird den Tempelritter-Schatz finden. Abenteuerfilm von Jon Turteltaub, mit Nicolas Cage, Diane Kruger und Ed Harris.

programme.title: CSI: Vegas
programme.desc: Die junge Tennisspielerin Claudia Weber steht erstmals im Finale eines Profiturniers. Doch am Morgen vor dem Spiel wird sie tot aufgefunden. Die Obduktion zeigt, dass sie schon früher schwere Kopf- und Hirnverletzungen erlitten hat.

programme.title: CSI: Vegas

programme.title: CSI: Vegas
programme.desc: Estefan Mejia ist es gelungen, die regimetreue kubanische Sängerin Silvana Cuerto nach Las Vegas zu holen. Nach der Probe finden Silvana und ihr Manager Antonio Silvanas Schwester Marta tot in der Garderobe. An der Wand steht die Botschaft, dass Silvana die Nächste sei. Die Ermittler vermuten zuerst einen Racheakt von Exil-Kubanern. Doch dann entdeckt Greg die familiären Zusammenhänge zwischen Estefan Mejia und den Cuerto-Schwestern.

programme.title: Der Blaulicht Report - Einzeleinsätze

programme.title: Der Blaulicht Report - Einzeleinsätze

Viele von ihnen nicht freiwillig. Sie werden offenbar mit falschen Versprechen ins Land gelockt und dann an die Front geschickt. So erging es auch einem Familienvater aus Sri Lanka: Er ging für ein vermeintlich gutes Jobangebot nach Russland und fand sich wenig später im Krieg wieder. Jetzt sitzt er wie viele andere ausländische Söldner in ukrainischer Gefangenschaft und weiß nicht, wann er in seine Heimat zurückkehren kann.

programme.title: Extra
programme.desc: Der große Refurbished -Test: Auf der Spur desSecond-Hand-Hypes (Frei für Online und TV)Alles wird teurer - kein Wunder also, dassSecond-Hand-Produkte boomen. Laut einer Studie aus 2024/2025 haben rund 55 %der Befragten in Deutschland in den letzten zwölf Monaten Second-Hand-Produktegekauft. Viele kennen das eher von Kleidung. Aber auch Elektrogeräte könnenzweitverwertet werden. Auf Plattformen wie Refurbed, BackMarket oder Swappiekann man beim Kauf eines Smartphones oder eines Haushaltsgerätes bis zu 50 %sparen. Doch spart man damit wirklich? Bekommt man gute Produkte zum super Sparpreisoder ist das alles kaputter Ramsch? Der große Extra-Test Der Extra Sonnencreme-Report Mit Sonnen-Öl und Lichtschutzfaktor 8 in der prallen Sonne liegen, um schönbraun zu werden, war gestern. Die Gefahr von Hautkrebs und dass man sich vorStrahlen schützen muss, ist mittlerweile bei jedem angekommen. Sonnencremes mitLSF 50 werden dabei immer beliebter. Aber was bedeutet die 50 auf der Flascheeigentlich im Vergleich zur 30 und welche Menge sollte man anwenden? Wirchecken mit einer UV-Kamera, wie gut sich die Deutschen eincremen und checken weitere UV-Gadgets wir Perlen-Armbänder, UV-Sticker und Apps. Bieten die außergewöhnlichen Hilfsmittel wirksamen Schutz? Außerdem:Nachdem wir aufgedeckt haben, dass einige Sonnencremes im Handel einengefährlichen UV-Filter enthalten, haben die Hersteller nachgebessert. Ökotesthat diese Sonnencremes getestet. Vier sind Testsieger, weil sie nicht nurschützen, sondern auch keinen schädlichen UV-Filter erhalten. Aber einigefallen glatt durch. Und wir zeigen auch, welche Sonnencremes denLichtschutzfaktor halten, den sie versprechen. Dreiste Miet-Abzocke mittels Eigenbedarfs Im Düsseldorfer Stadtteil Golzheim werden Wohnungen mittlerweile für 31Euro kalt pro Quadratmeter angeboten. Der aktuelle Mietspiegel liegt jedoch beimaximal 15EUR pro Quadratmeter. Wir schauen uns eine dieser Wohnungen an undkönnen kaum glauben, was hinter der horrenden Miete steckt: Die Vormieterin,eine 71-jährige Rentnerin, wurde unter fadenscheinigen Gründen aus ihrerlangjährigen Wohnung gedrängt. Der Verdacht: Eigenbedarf als Vorwand und eineRenovierung als Schlupfloch, um höhere Mieten durchzusetzen. Unser Beitragdeckt die Methoden skrupelloser Vermieter auf - von systematischem Rausekelnüber dubiose Leerstände bis hin zu überteuerten Neuvermietungen. Mitversteckter Kamera, Betroffenen, einer Eskalation mit Polizeieinsatz, derKonfrontation von Verantwortlichen und der Frage: Warum lässt die Stadt das zu?Und was macht zum Beispiel die Stadt Wien deutlich besser als wir?

programme.title: Kohtalokas syrjähyppy (16)
programme.desc: Kaunis runoilija Clara rakastuu tulisesti John Hjortfeldtiin. Hän jättää mustasukkaisen miehensä Johnin takia. Perheellinen John taas alkaa elää kaksoiselämää. Clara huomaa, että häntä seurataan ja vahditaan. Kuka on asialla, ja miksi?

programme.title: Stieg Larsson: Mies joka leikki tulella (12)
programme.desc: Ruotsalainen dokumenttielokuva Millennium-kirjojen luojasta Stieg Larssonista ja hänen riskialttiista tutkimuksistaan äärioikeistoryhmien parissa.

programme.title: Vingar av glas (12)
programme.desc: Nazli on syntynyt Irakissa ja varttunut Ruotsissa. Hän haluaa sulautua yhteiskuntaan ja kutsuu itseään Saraksi, mikä surettaa hänen isäänsä, joka haluaa hänet naimisiin irakilaisen kanssa. Pian Sara tapaa Johanin, mikä ei helpota tilannetta.

programme.title: Loranga, Masarin ja Dartanjang (7)
programme.desc: Loranga on maailman paras isä. Vaikka hän on aikuinen, hän rakastaa poppia eikä halua mennä töihin, koska leikkii poikansa Masarinin kanssa. Dartanjang asuu vajassa, koska pelkää bakteereita. Hän on siitä huolimatta jatkuvasti kipeänä.

programme.title: Bert - viimeinen viaton (S)
programme.desc: Bertiä koetellaan. Hän on juuri aloittanut yhdeksännen luokan ja ajattelee tyttöjä koko ajan. Kaikki paitsi hän seurustelevat jo ja ovat tehneet SITÄ satoja kertoja. Ainoa mahdollisuus päästä eroon viimeisen neitsyen taakasta on Victoria - ihana pikku olento, joka ilmaantuu Bertin kotipaikkakunnalle Öreskogaan aivan pääkaupungista saakka. Mutta Victoria ihastuu blondiin kiiltokuvapoika Carl-Philipiin, jolla on pitkä, hulmuava tukka...

programme.title: Vitun neljätoista (12)
programme.desc: 14-vuotias Emma on vaihtamassa pikkutyttöporukkaansa isonveljensä kaveripiiriin. Heidän maailmansa on aivan uudenlainen, ja Emmalle käy huonosti. Pian lapsuuden ja nuoruuden välillä taiteileva Emma tapaa kömpelön skeittarin nimeltä Aron.

programme.title: Bröderna Karlsson (12)
programme.desc: Karlssonin veljekset ovat kaksosia, mutta eivät tiedä toistensa olemassaolosta. Yksi on menestynyt ja tarkka lakimies Tukholmassa ja toinen vetelä vilunki pohjoisesta. Veljekset kohtaavat toisensa perunkirjoituksessa, ja seuraukset mullistavat molempien elämän.

programme.title: 10 000 Timmar (S)
programme.desc: Kun Eric saa voiton raaputusarvalla, hän sijoittaa kaiken unelmansa toteuttamiseen. Hän haluaa ammattilaisjalkapalloilijaksi, vaikka onkin 36-vuotias eikä edes taitava pelaaja. Ilmeisesti tarvitaan vain 10 000 tuntia harjoitusta, jos on uskominen Ericin opaskirjaa. Vaimo haluaisi käyttää rahat järkevästi, mutta Erik ryhtyy ystävänsä Bengtssonin ja puoliammattilaisen Toran avulla toteuttamaan unelmaansa.

programme.title: Medicinen (7)
programme.desc: Tässä Colin Nutleyn komediassa Johannasta tulee koehenkilö, jolla testataan uutta lääkettä. Lääkkeellä on odottamattomia sivuvaikutuksia.

programme.title: En förälskelse
programme.desc: Simon ja Ingrid elävät täydellistä elämää: heillä on hyvät työpaikat, ihanat puolisot ja melkein aikuiset lapset. He eivät koskaan ole tavanneet, mutta eräänä kesäiltana heidän tiensä kohtaavat. He rakastuvat, ja alkaa monimutkainen suhde.

programme.title: G
programme.desc: Elokuva rakkaudesta, ystävyydestä, hasiksesta ja rock'n'rollista! Robban käyttää huumeita ja liikkuu oudoissa piireissä. Alex on kellaribändin laulaja. Kim on rakastunut Miaan, mutta häntä vetää puoleensa myös Kristoffer, G-klubin omistaja.

programme.title: Kissanviiksiä ja herneitä (S)
programme.desc: Kömpelön jokapaikanhöylän Claes-Henrikin on huijattava äitinsä ulos asunnosta pariksi päiväksi. Rahaa on luvassa, mutta tehtävä ei ole helppo.

programme.title: Monica Z (12)
programme.desc: Monica, nuori, kapinallinen pikkukaupungin tyttö on päättänyt menestyä laulajana Tukholman eloisilla jazzklubeilla. Hän aloittaa unelmiensa laulajan uran, jonka aikana upea laulaja/näyttelijä kehittyy jazzin kultaisella aikakaudella.

programme.title: Kaarle XVI Kustaa (S)
programme.desc: Elokuvaohjaaja Karin af Klintberg pommitti Ruotsin hovin tiedotusosastoa viesteillä kahden vuoden ajan. Lopulta hän sai ensimmäisenä toimittajana myöntävän vastauksen ja ainutlaatuisen tilaisuuden seurata läheltä kuningas Kaarle XVI Kustaan elämää ja työtä.

programme.title: Pensionaatti Oskar (12)
programme.desc: Pensionaatti Oskar on tavallinen mökkikylä minigolfeineen, kahviloineen ja rumine merenrantamökkeineen. Paikalle saapuu tuiki tavallinen Runebergin perhe huonotapaisine lapsineen. He luulevat että edessä on aivan tavallinen kesäloma...

programme.title: Niin kuin taivaassa (12)
programme.desc: Kansainvälisesti tunnettu kapellimestari ottaa johtaakseen pienen norlantilaisen kirkkokuoron.

programme.title: Levoton Sussie (16)
programme.desc: Erik matkustaa kotikaupunkiinsa etsiäkseen kadonneen pikkusiskonsa. Pian hän huomaa, ettei Pikku-Sussie olekaan enää se viaton kiltti tyttö, jonka hän tunsi.

programme.title: Vinterviken
programme.desc: Elisabeth on yläluokkainen tyttö, John-John kundi betonilähiöstä. Maantieteellisesti heidän välillään on vain lahti, mutta muuten olosuhteet heidän rakkaudelleen eivät voisi olla huonommat. Klassinen rakkaustarina modernilla virityksellä.

programme.title: Bang Bang Orangutang
programme.desc: Menestyksekäs liikemies Åke Jönsson rakastaa itseään. Ja uraansa. Ja suurta, kallista autoaan. Yhtäkkiä hänen elämänsä muuttuu. Hän kaipaa vaimoaan ja lapsiaan, joita on uransa keskellä unohtanut rakastaa. Åke alkaa tavoitella rakkautta.

programme.title: Veijarikoplan suurin keikka (7)
programme.desc: Herman Melvin (Stellan Skarsgård) lyöttäytyy yhteen Veijarikoplan kanssa. Tällä kertaa kopla ryöstää setelipainon ja joutuu hankaluuksiin Puolassa.

programme.title: Bonusperhe-elokuva (7)
programme.desc: Lisan ja Patrikin liitto on taas paremmalla tolalla Patrikin uskottomuuden jäljiltä, mutta sitten käräjäoikeudesta saapuu yllättävä kirje. Lisa on unohtanut vireille panemansa avioerohakemuksen, ja nyt ero on astunut voimaan. Järkyttynyt Patrik päättää yllättää Lisan hääjuhlallisuuksilla. Pian selviää, että Lisakin on ollut uskoton, ja asetelma keikahtaa päälaelleen. Elokuva on jatkoa suositulle Bonusperhe-tv-sarjalle. Ohjaaja: Felix Herngren. Rooleissa: Vera Vitali, Erik Johansson, Fredrik Hallgren, Klara Hodell, Christer Lindarw, Marianne Mörck, Johan Ulveson.

programme.title: Mies, joka rakasti järjestystä (12)
programme.desc: 59-vuotias Ove on kärttyinen naapurikyttääjä. Koominen ja sydämellinen tarina saa alkunsa, kun viimeisillään raskaana oleva Parvaneh muuttaa perheineen vastapäiseen taloon ja peruuttaa päin Oven postilaatikkoa.

programme.title: Työkeikka (7)
programme.desc: Parhaat ystävykset Lotta ja Pernilla tekevät samaa työtä samalla työpaikalla, mutta nyt puhaltavat muutoksen tuulet, mikä vaikuttaa muuhunkin elämään.

programme.title: Yrrol
programme.desc: Lorry-porukan hulvaton elokuva, jossa vilahtavat mm. alaosaton baarimikko, väkivaltainen lentoemäntä, viisi kirkuvaa Pelastusarmeijan sotilasta, sokea TV-kauppias, likainen tennispallo sekä tietenkin Bosse-setä - likaisempana kuin ikinä.

programme.title: Svensson Svensson (7)
programme.desc: Kun Lenalle tarjotaan jännittävää työpaikkaa Tukholmasta, hän joutuu matkustamaan pääkaupungin ja Vivallan väliä. Gustav alkaa kuitenkin kaivata Lenaa, joten hän myy talon ja kääntää kokkansa Tukholmaa kohti - eikä mikään ole ennallaan.

programme.title: Kurt Olsson - Filmen om mitt liv som mej själv
programme.desc: Tarina kansan rakastamasta Kurt Olssonista, jolla vuosien kuluessa tuntuu olleen sormensa pelissä joka paikassa, ja jotenkin kaikki menee pieleen.

programme.title: Arn - Temppeliritari (12)
programme.desc: Jan Guilloun menestyskirjat Arn Magnussonista ovat taustana kalleimmalle Ruotsissa koskaan tehdylle filmisijoitukselle.

programme.title: Rahalla saa 2 (16)
programme.desc: JW oli lupaava opiskelija Tukholman Kauppakorkeakolussa. Hän kuitenkin himoitsi nopeaa rahaa niin kipeästi, että se koitui hänen kohtalokseen. Neljän vankilassa vietetyn vuoden jälkeen hän haluaa vaihtaa elämänsä suuntaa, mutta se onkin yllättävän vaikeaa.

programme.title: Tommy (16)
programme.desc: Viikkoa ennen joulua laskeutuu Estelle Svensson Tukholman Arlandaan. Vuotta aiemmin joutui hän pakenemaan tyttärensä ja aviomiehensä Tommyn kanssa ulkomaille, kun aviomies oli suunnitellut ja toteuttanut Ruotsin rikoshistorian kaikkien aikojen suurimman pankkiryöstön.

programme.title: Tässä on elämäsi (16)
programme.desc: Klassinen filmatisointi Eyvind Johnsonin romaanisarjasta, jossa Olof jättää vuonna 1914 kotinsa Norlannissa ja lähtee maailmalle.

programme.title: Amorosa (16)
programme.desc: Draama kirjailija Agnes von Krusenstjernasta, aatelisrouvasta, joka sai aikaan skandaalin kehdatessaan täyttää romaaninsa rakkaudella ja erotiikalla.

programme.title: Kesälesket (12)
programme.desc: Kaksi kundia joilla on hyvin erilaiset taustat ja arvot kohtaavat kuuman kesäviikon aikana Tukholmassa. Heidän vaimonsa ovat matkoilla. Lasse on valmistautunut tyypilliseen poikamiesviikkoon, Gary taas rauhalliseen työviikkoon...

programme.desc: Komediasarja kuuden ystävyksen yhteiselosta. Phoebelle paljastuu, etteivät elokuvat olekaan kaikki ihania ja onnellisia. Richardista tulee Joeyn ja Chandlerin uusi kamu ja...isä. Ben lausuu Rossin iloksi ensimmäiset sanansa.

programme.title: Frendit
programme.desc: Monican ja Rachelin tanssiaisvideo paljastaa Monican aiemman ympärysmitan, Rachelin entisen nenän ja Rossin kauan kestäneet tunteet.

programme.title: Melkein MENSA
programme.desc: Tupla-Kääkin vetäjät Kirsikka Simberg ja Enni Koistinen sekä artisti Hesaäijä ottavat mittaa yleistiedoistaan yhdessä vakiokapteeni Eero Ritalan kanssa. Juha Perälä luotsaa kysymyksiä teemoista lelut ja hallitsijat.

programme.title: Silent Library Suomi
programme.desc: Hiljaisuutta pyydän! Kirjastossa tehtävien tiimellyksessä ovat tänään Pekka Hyysalo, Petteri Halme, Samuli Rönkkönen, Van Padhaal, Niklas Mattson sekä Lari Mallius. Kirjastokuria ylläpitää Riku Rantala.

programme.title: Silent Library Suomi

programme.title: Onnenpyörä VIP
programme.desc: UUSI SARJA ALKAA! Cristal Snow ja Niko Saarinen juontavat Onnenpyörä VIP -viihdevisailua, jossa julkkikset kisaavat paikasta finaalissa. Finaalivoittaja valitsee palkintosummalleen oman hyväntekeväisyyskohteen.

programme.title: Lapin poliisit
programme.desc: Hevonen karkaa tunturirallin erikoiskokeella. Katajamäki ja Oja etsivät Leville eksynyttä vähäpukeista naista.

programme.title: Lapin poliisit
programme.desc: Rekkamies hermostuu erikoisesti saadessaan huomautuksen lastinsa kiinnityksestä Muurolassa. Vasenius ja Autti partioivat tuhannen neliökilometrin laajuisella Inarinjärvellä.

programme.title: Lapin poliisit
programme.desc: Jänkälä ja Vähänikkilä saavat ilmoituksia kotiväkivallasta. Sodankylässä naisten riita miehestä vaatii sivullisen uhrin

programme.title: Kathleen Tagg And Andre Petersen - Classical:NEXT 2019 - Tagg And Petersen
programme.desc: The Kathleen Tagg / Andre Petersen piano duo brings together two of South Africa's most celebrated pianists: one eclectic-experimental classical and one jazz artist, in a unique and highly personal collaboration. Drawing inspiration from the rich sonic tapestries of classical music, nuances of South African jazz and traditional musics from sub-Saharan Africa, this duo explodes the concept of what two pianos can sound like: a bass guitar, goema drum, marimba and uhadi–plus mixing fully composed scores with improvisation in a bold, vital and highly entertaining mix with performances of original compositions and works by iconic South African jazz composers such as Abdullah Ibrahim, Bheki Mseleku and Moses Molelekwa. Tagg and Petersen explore diverse realms of possibilities within the sound world of the piano, their musical offerings paying tribute to the poignant legacy of people who have inspired their world-view and music making. In this performance from the 2019 edition of Classical:NEXT!, the talented pianists perform Bheki Mseleku, Angola, African Dawn / Cape Doctor, Second Time Around, Rapela, Time Watchers and Berimbau.

programme.title: Maria Ana Bobone - Portrait of Maria Ana Bobone
programme.desc: Maria Ana Bobone (Portugal) is one of the best fado singers of her generation. She started singing fado when she was 16. Her debut album is called ‘Alma Nova’ and marked the beginning of her amazing career. For the recordings of her next two albums, ‘Luz Destino’ and ‘Senhora da Lapa’ Maria Ana welcomed instruments that are usually not present in fado music: the harpsichord and saxophone. After that, she continued her career with the release of ‘Nome de Mar’, which received many positive reviews. At the moment, Maria Ana is performing at all Portugal’s major venues, as well as many festivals and concert halls throughout the world, with the aim to present fado music and Portuguese culture to other cultures. Bobone’s latest album, ‘Fado And Piano’, shows her diversity as an artist, composer and arranger. By including the piano she re-innovates the tradition of the early 20th century. This portrait shows Maria Ana’s performances and interviews in which she explains her passion for fado music and culture.

programme.title: Aki Rissanen, Antti Lotjonen And Teppo Mäkynen - Aki Rissanen Trio at Jazzclub Unterfahrt, Munich
programme.desc: Aki Rissanen's interest in jazz came after he started taking classical piano lessons. His deep interest in improvised music placed him among top jazz pianist in his home country - Finland. While composing and performing his own music, Rissanen has also collaborated with Verneri Pohjola and Dave Liebman, and today his name appears among the top European jazz musicians. Live from 'Jazzclub Unterfahrt' in Munich, Germany, together with Antti Lotjonen on bass and Teppo Makynen on drums, Rissanen showcases the best of Scandinavian jazz and its DNA - the Nordic Tone.

programme.title: Bloco do O - Bloco do O - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the bands taking part in this series is Bloco do Ó, a traditional street band associated with the Brazilian carnival. A bloco is a group of people who drive through the streets in trucks, playing music and providing fun to anyone who will listen. Immerse yourself in Bloco de Ó's world of cheerful melodies and spectacular costumes!

programme.title: Avishai Cohen - 4K Clips
programme.desc: Stunning 4K clips from the world of pop, rock, jazz, classical music, dance, and theater

programme.title: Christa Ludwig And Charles Spencer - Christa Ludwig - Tribute to Vienna
programme.desc: Christa Ludwig offers a last performance before taking her leave of the opera and concert stage. In a final Lieder recital from the Wiener Musikverein, honouring the city that has seen her greatest triumphs and that has been her spiritual home, Ms. Ludwig performs a select repertoire of Beethoven, Schubert, Mahler and Wolf. She had given her first recital at this historic venue in 1965, only six years after her debut at the Metropolitan Opera. Now, before a huge audience of understandably adoring classical music lovers, she returns to the stage of numerous solo triumphs with a carefully chosen program of Lieder. Ludwig is accompanied by pianist Charles Spencer. The concert takes place at the Wiener Musikverein in 1994.

programme.title: Sébastien Daucé And Ensemble Correspondances - Daucé conducts Charpentier and Du Mont
programme.desc: Harpsichordist and organist Sébastien Daucé leads Ensemble Correspondances in this concert recorded as part of the Valletta International Baroque Festival of 2017 at the Co-Cathédrale de St-Jean de la Valette in Malta. The concert opens with a rendition of Marc-Antoine Charpentier’s late-17th century composition Te Deum. The joyful and popular prelude of this piece is familiar to many as the Eurovision Anthem. Furthermore, the concert program is made up of motets by Henry du Mont (1610-1694), an organist and baroque composer of the French school, born in the Southern Netherlands. Among his musical heirs were Jean-Baptiste Lully (1632-1687) and François Couperin (1668-1733).

programme.title: Ben Sluijs - Belgium Sessions: Ben Sluijs
programme.desc: In this DJAZZ Belgium Sessions performance, which was recorded at AED Studios in Lint, Belgium, we witness Europe’s finest jazz musicians at work. A wide variety of international jazz musicians give a creative, up-close and inside insight into their art of playing jazz music. Young talent and established jazz musicians play to their heart’s content. Saxophonist Ben Sluijs received a classical training. He has a strong melodic and harmonic approach to music. His music offers no room for showing off: it’s all about the music itself. Sluijs’ fascination for jazz developed after his cum laude graduation, inspiring him to take lessons with the American saxophonist and flutist David Liebman in the USA.

programme.title: Utrecht Early Music Festival - Music of Naples
programme.desc: Throughout the centuries, the Italian city of Naples has proved to have a remarkably favorable climate for artistic innovation. The presence of the royal or vice royal courts, the practice of music in churches, fraternities, and charitable institutions, financial support from well-to-do citizens, and the popularity of song and dance in public life made for an extraordinarily diverse musical landscape.

programme.title: Mariss Jansons And Bavarian Radio Symphony Orchestra - Mussorgsky - Pictures at an Exhibition
programme.desc: Conductor Mariss Jansons, the Bavarian Radio Symphony Orchestra and Mussorgsky's “Pictures at an Exhibition” were predestined to come together. The lavish colors of Ravel's orchestration of the Russian work, the breathtaking inventiveness of the wildly different movements that are all interconnected through a recurring “Promenade” – few conductors are as adept as Jansons to savor all the richness and colorfulness of the paintings and sketches by Victor Hartmann. Today, the work is universally celebrated in its dazzling orchestral transcription by Maurice Ravel. It was the great conductor Serge Koussevitzky who commissioned the orchestration by Ravel in 1922. Recorded at Herkulessaal, Munich in 2014.

programme.title: Branford Marsalis Quartet - Branford Marsalis Quartet - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1987, jazz saxophonist Branford Marsalis brought his band to the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. This broadcast presents a selection of that performance, displaying the magical and mesmerising energy coming from the legendary saxophone virtuoso and member of the Marsalis jazz dynasty.

programme.title: Fuá Do Guegué - Forró Series
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed and curated in São Paulo by director and presenter Dani Gurgel and producer and engineer Thiago Rabello, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. Curated by its percussionist and leader, Guegué Medeiros, the collective Fuá Do Guegué aims to bring together professionals and artists who identify with and value the rhythms, characteristics, and art of Brazil’s Northeast. With a healthy disregard for preconceived notions and restraints, the collective combines music, film, and dance in their eclectic and highly energetic sets. Fuá Do Guegué consists of Guegué Medeiros (percussion); Salomão Soares (piano); Lau Trajano (bass); Danilo Moraes, Beibe, and Janayna Pereira (percussion and vocals); and Olivio Filho (accordion).

programme.title: Riccardo Schwartz - Schumann - Fantasie in C, Op. 17
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birthday, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. His Fantasie in C, Op. 17, was written in 1836. It was revised prior to publication in 1839 and dedicated to Franz Liszt. It is one of Schumann's greatest works for solo piano and a central work of the early Romantic period.

programme.title: The Ensemble HOPE - Classical:NEXT 2019 - Ensemble HOPE
programme.desc: The Ensemble HOPE is dedicated to the performance and creation of music of today. As well as exploring new forms of contemporary electro-acoustic technology, it integrates written musical tradition, improvisation and an adapted classical repertoire. The Cristal Baschet and the Euphone form the basis of the ensemble's sophisticated instrumental collection. The new works reflect these neglected and little-known instruments. The Ensemble HOPE, consisting of Frederic Bousquet (Euphone), Marc Antoine Millon (Bass Cristal) and Armelle Marq (soprano voice), is also actively engaged in developing a new generation of Euphones. In this concert from 2019's Classical:NEXT!, the ensemble performs Frederic Bousquet's Vénus, Epilogue and en transit, Henry Purcell's Dido’s lament, arranged by M.A. Millon, Georg Friedrich Händel's Lascia ch'io pianga, arranged by M.A. Millon, as well as works by Eric Satie, Roger Steptoe, Bruno Giner, and Marc Antoine Millon.

programme.title: Raphael Pichon - Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Fran Nóbrega - Forró Series
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed and curated in São Paulo by director and presenter Dani Gurgel and producer and engineer Thiago Rabello, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. Drawing from her Brazilian roots, upcoming vocalist Fran Nóbrega is poring today’s underground scene to bring us the latest trends in forró and popular Brazilian music. Her album “A flor e o Tempo” has won her a strong cult following, and her performances exude positive energy: get ready to dance to Nóbrega’s exciting set!

programme.title: Anner Bylsma - Bach - Cello Suite No. 1 in G major, BWV 1007
programme.desc: At St. Bartholomew Church in Dornheim, Germany, where composer Johann Sebastian Bach married his first wife Maria Barbara, renowned Dutch cellist Anner Bijlsma performs the composer's Cello Suite No. 1 in G major, BWV 1007. It is likely Bach wrote his collection of six Suites for unaccompanied cello during the years 1717-1723. His cello suites are an essential part of the cello repertoire, highlighting the instrument's manifold polyphonic possibilities. As customary in a Baroque suite, each movement is based on a dance type. Bach's Suite No. 1 opens with a prelude, and is followed by six dance movements, divided over five sections: an allemande, a courante, a sarabande, two minuets, and a final gigue.

programme.title: Verônica Ferriani - MPB Sessions - Verônica Ferriani
programme.desc: Verônica Ferriani is a Brazilian singer and songwriter recognized for her powerful voice and distinctive musical identity. Her career spans a variety of styles within MPB (Brazilian Popular Music), and she stands out for the intensity and emotion of her performances. In her shows, Verônica presents a mix of works inspired by personal experiences, tributes to her major influences, and selections from her own compositions. How do contemporary artists reinterpret tradition and create new forms of expression within MPB? Da Pá Virada Sessions' MPB Series investigates this question. Hosted by Dani Gurgel, this episode features a live performance and thought-provoking conversation with Verônica Ferriani, exploring her unique fusion of styles and inviting audiences to discover the richness of modern Brazilian music. Continue your journey into the rich world of contemporary Brazilian popular music with Stingray DJAZZ.

programme.title: Václav Luks And Collegium 1704 - Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 2
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021. The concertos are based on the Italian concerto grosso form, in which a group of solo instruments is set against a large ensemble. Bach’s Brandenburg Concertos feature remarkable combinations of solo instruments and virtuoso solos. In this performance at the Hall of Mirrors in the Köthen Castle, Germany, Luks and his Collegium 1704 present Bach’s Brandenburg Concerto No. 2 in F major, BWV 1047. This piece features trumpet, violin, recorder, and oboe solos. Especially outstanding are the high, virtuoso trumpet parts.

programme.title: Archibald - DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Zhu Xiao-Mei - Bach - Goldberg Variations (BWV 988)
programme.desc: Chinese pianist Zhu Xiao-Mei performs J. S. Bach's Goldberg Variations (BWV 988) at the Leipzig Bach Festival. This June 2014 concert was recorded at St. Thomas Church, where Bach spent most time of his career as 'Thomaskantor', the musical director of the Thomanerchor church choir. The Goldberg Variations consist of one aria and a set of 30 variations. The work was first published in 1741 and was named after harpsichordist Johann Gottlieb Goldberg. In contrast to melodic variations on a theme, the Goldberg Variations do not follow the melody, but rather use the aria's bass line and chord progression. Every third variation in the series of 30 is a canon that follows an ascending pattern. The Goldberg Variations are among Bach's most celebrated works, which gained an even larger audience thanks to Glenn Gould's legendary recordings of the work in 1955 and 1981.

programme.title: Fay Claassen - Fay Claassen: Two Portraits of Chet Baker
programme.desc: In 2013 it is 25 years ago that singer and trumpet player Chet Baker mysteriously died, caused by a fall from the window of his hotel room in Amsterdam. His music is more popular than ever. This concert is performed by Fay Claassen, who became internationally known through her album ‘Two Portraits of Chet Baker’. In the U.S. this album was the ‘Best Vocal Album of the Year’. In this concert Fay Claassen brings a tribute to Baker with the most beautiful songs and improvisations.

programme.title: Maria Zubimendi, Gorka Catediano And Jon Ansorena - Classical:NEXT 2019 - Trio Zukan
programme.desc: In 2014, Trio Zukan emerged from the combination of three uncommon instruments: accordion, percussion and txistu. The repertoire for this instrumental combination was non-existent at the beginning, so its members decided to promote a project with different composers, with the intention of creating a new repertoire. Today, Zukan has commissioned, revised and released more than a dozen pieces by national and international composers such as: María Eugenia Luc, Mikel Chamizo, Isabel Urrutia, Francisco José Domínguez, Vassilis Filippou, etc. The group is one of the most consolidated groups on the contemporary music scene in the Basque Country. They have performed in Quincena Musical Donostia, Bernaola Festival, Musikagileak Circuit, BBVA Cycle and Attacca Basel, among others. In this concert from the 2019 edition of Classical:NEXT!, Maria Zubimendi (accordion), Gorka Catediano (percussion) and Jon Ansorena (txistu) perform the works X. Otaolea, Gravity, F. Rzewski, as arranged by Trio Zukan, To the Earth, Seis miradas sobre and many more.

programme.title: Andre Marques - Andre Marques - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the artists taking part in this series is pianist, composer, and arranger André Marques. He has been building a solid career, releasing his music with numerous groups: he is a member of the Latin Grammy-nominated Trio Curupira, the André Marques Sexteto, and he leads the Brazilian music orchestra Vintena Brasileira. In this episode of Da Pá Virada Sessions, André Marques performs an intimate solo piano recital.

programme.title: Valerius Ensemble, Eeva Koskinen, Réne Geesing And Ingo Lulofs - Rachmaninoff And Dvořák Trios
programme.desc: The Valerius Ensemble, consisting of Eeva Koskinen (violin), René Geesing (cello) and Ingo Lulofs (piano) plays Rachmaninoff’s Trio élégiaque Nr. 1 and the Finale of Dvořák’s Piano Trio No.3, Op. 65. Rachmaninoff composed this Trio in 1892 at the age of 19. The work does not have an opus number and consists only of one movement, which is highly unusual for a Piano Trio. This concert was recorded at Muziekcentrum Enschede in the Netherlands on March 18, 2018.

programme.title: George Shearing And Neil Swanson - George Shearing Duo feat. Neil Swainson
programme.desc: British pianist George Shearing enjoyed an international reputation as an instrumentalist, arranger, and composer. Equally at home on the classical concert stage as in jazz clubs, he was recognized for his inventive, orchestrated jazz. In this live recording from the Munich Philharmonie, Shearing played in a duo format with Canadian double bassist Neil Swainson. The repertoire consisted of a selection of compositions by Shearing himself, among them ‘Lullaby Of Birdland’, which is a standard in jazz repertoire.

programme.title: Olivier Latry - In the Organ's Stomach
programme.desc: Olivier Latry is the current holder of the Great Organ of Notre Dame. Between its original religious function and the interest of composers of all times, the great organ Cavaillé-Coll reveals its absolute modernity. Latry is considered one of the greatest organists of his generation, both in France and internationally. He sees himself as an ambassador of French music from the 17th through the 20th centuries as well as an advocate for the art of improvisation. Pieces played in the film are: Pierre Cochereau’s Boléro, Louis Vierne’s Carillon of Westminster and Scherzo from Symphony No. 2, Alexandre Guilmant’s Sonata No. 1, Charles-Marie Widor’s Gothic Symphony, Marcel Dupre’s Cortège, Litanie and J. S. Bach’s Passacaille And Fugue.

programme.title: Raul Midón - 4K Clips
programme.desc: Stunning 4K clips from the world of pop, rock, jazz, classical music, dance, and theater

programme.title: Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah - Live at A to JazZ Festival, Sofia
programme.desc: In 2019, the vibrant city of Sofia, Bulgaria, hosted the International A to JazZ Festival. Among the featured acts was the trailblazing jazz trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah. This genre-defying artist captivated the audience with his eclectic “stretch music”; an approach that incorporates hip-hop and reaches back through the American canon into African percussion and its rich melodic content. Trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah’s quintet, which includes drummer Corey Fonville, percussionist Weedie Braimah, pianist Lawrence Fields, and bass guitarist Max Mucha, delivered a performance that defied boundaries and expectations.

programme.title: Fanfaraï - DJAZZ Portrait: Fanfaraï
